title: Variationally correct operator learning: Reduced basis neural operator with a posteriori error estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的变分正确算子学习框架和误差估计方法可直接迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中，解决昂贵仿真的采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification beyond a posteriori error estimation.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准神经算子的残差损失缺乏变分正确性，小残差不保证小误差。
summary_zh.method: 构建FOSLS目标函数并设计降基神经算子RBNO，确保范数等价和变分稳定性。
summary_zh.result: 在扩散和线弹性问题上，所提方法在PDE范数下精度优于基线，残差损失可作为可靠的后验误差估计。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证理论误差界和精度优势。

summary_en.motivation: Standard neural operator training with PDE residual losses lacks variational correctness, where small residuals do not guarantee small solution errors.
summary_en.method: A variationally correct operator learning framework is developed using first-order system least-squares (FOSLS) objectives and a Reduced Basis Neural Operator (RBNO) that ensures function space conformity.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves superior accuracy in PDE-compliant norms on stationary diffusion and linear elasticity benchmarks, and the residual loss serves as a reliable a posteriori error estimator.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks validate the theoretical error bounds and demonstrate improved accuracy over standard baselines.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的可学习分数幂基神经网络架构，有望用于生物力学有限元代理模型中奇异函数（如应力集中）的高效逼近。
why_not_core: No direct application to FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics; no validation on biomedical or structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准激活函数难以逼近具有奇异或分数幂行为的函数。
summary_zh.method: 提出Müntz-Szász网络，用可学习的分数幂基替换固定激活函数。
summary_zh.result: 在奇异函数回归和PINN基准上，误差降低3-8倍，参数减少10倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在奇异ODE和边界层PINN问题上验证，学习到的指数匹配解结构。

summary_en.motivation: Standard activation functions are ill-suited for approximating functions with singular or fractional power behavior common in physics.
summary_en.method: We introduce Müntz-Szász Networks (MSN), which replace fixed activations with learnable fractional power bases grounded in classical approximation theory.
summary_en.result: MSN achieves 5-8x lower error on singular regression and 3-6x improvement on PINN benchmarks with 10x fewer parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validation on PINN benchmarks including a singular ODE and stiff boundary-layer problems, where learned exponents match known solution structure.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of Bayesian inverse problems reliant on expensive high-fidelity solvers.

summary_en.validation: Validated on two numerical benchmark inverse problems involving steady groundwater flow and an unsteady reaction-diffusion system.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较法国悖论与标准骨水泥技术对股骨柄稳定性的影响。

summary_en.method: Stems were implanted into four pairs of human cadaveric femurs, and micromotion was measured using five LVDTs during cyclic axial and torsional loading.
summary_en.result: Both techniques resulted in well-fixed stems with mean permanent migration below 20 μm and inducible motions below 100 μm, with no significant differences.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through in vitro cadaveric mechanical testing with a joint motion simulator.

title: Hybrid Iterative Solvers with Geometry-Aware Neural Preconditioners for Parametric PDEs

summary_en.motivation: Classical iterative solvers for parametric PDEs are highly sensitive to domain geometry and discretization, limiting their generalization.
summary_en.method: We propose Geo-DeepONet, a geometry-aware deep operator network that extracts domain information from finite element meshes to learn operators across arbitrary unstructured grids without retraining.
summary_en.result: The hybrid preconditioned iterative solvers, coupling Geo-DeepONet with relaxation or Krylov subspace methods, demonstrate enhanced robustness and efficiency on diverse unstructured domains.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on parametric PDEs over various unstructured domains validate the improved robustness and efficiency of the proposed hybrid solvers.

title: Derivative-Informed Fourier Neural Operator: Universal Approximation and Applications to PDE-Constrained Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的导数信息傅里叶神经算子（DIFNO）通过联合学习输出和Fréchet导数，显著提高了代理模型的样本效率，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模和约束优化问题。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate surrogate derivatives are essential for PDE-constrained optimization, but conventional FNOs lack derivative accuracy.
summary_en.method: We propose derivative-informed Fourier neural operators (DIFNOs) trained jointly on output and Fréchet derivative samples, with dimensionality reduction and multi-resolution techniques.
summary_en.result: DIFNOs achieve superior sample complexity and high accuracy in operator learning and inverse problems compared to standard FNOs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on nonlinear diffusion-reaction, Helmholtz, and Navier-Stokes equations demonstrate the effectiveness.

title: KD-PINN: Knowledge-Distilled PINNs for ultra-low-latency real-time neural PDE solvers
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的知识蒸馏PINN框架可显著加速PDE求解，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，实现超低延迟实时预测。

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN推理延迟高的问题，实现超低延迟实时PDE求解。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve ultra-low-latency real-time PDE solving by reducing inference latency of PINNs.
summary_en.method: A knowledge distillation framework that transfers accuracy from a high-capacity teacher PINN to a compact student via continuous KL divergence adaptation.
summary_en.result: The distilled student achieves 4.8x to 6.9x inference speedup on CPU with sub-10 ms latency and less than 1% accuracy loss across multiple PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE benchmarks including Burgers and Navier-Stokes equations, measuring inference latency and accuracy.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示Voronoi设计参数（随机点数与孔隙率）对仿生骨小梁支架性能的影响机制。
summary_zh.method: 设计不同随机点数和孔隙率的Voronoi支架，通过SLM制造，并进行力学测试、CFD模拟和骨长入分析。
summary_zh.result: 低孔隙率下随机点数少则力学性能好；高孔隙率下随机点数多则生物性能好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SLM制造和力学测试验证，结合CFD模拟流场均匀性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of random point number and porosity on the mechanical and biological performance of Voronoi-based bionic trabecular bone scaffolds.
summary_en.method: Voronoi scaffolds with varying random point numbers and porosities were designed, fabricated via selective laser melting (SLM), and evaluated through mechanical testing, CFD simulation, and bone ingrowth analysis.
summary_en.result: At low porosity, fewer random points yield higher yield strength (e.g., ~200 MPa for 10 points vs. ~130 MPa for 20/30 points at 50% porosity); higher random points improve flow uniformity and bone ingrowth at high porosity.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via SLM fabrication and mechanical testing, complemented by CFD simulation of internal fluid characteristics.

title: Flow matching Operators for Residual-Augmented Probabilistic Learning of Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于流匹配的算子学习方法，能够从低保真度近似映射到高保真度PDE解，并生成不确定性估计，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant or biomechanics problems, nor does it include any experimental or clinical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决数据稀缺下PDE概率代理学习困难的问题
summary_zh.method: 在无限维函数空间中使用流匹配，结合条件神经算子学习低到高保真解的残差校正
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上实现了跨分辨率和保真度的准确解算子学习，并提供了合理的不确定性估计
summary_zh.validation: 在1D对流、Burgers方程和2D Darcy流问题上进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Learning probabilistic surrogates for PDEs remains challenging in data-scarce regimes, as neural operators require large datasets and generative models lack resolution invariance.
summary_en.method: We formulate flow matching in infinite-dimensional function space with a conditional neural operator architecture using feature-wise linear modulation, parameterizing the flow vector field as a sum of linear and nonlinear operators to learn residual corrections from low-fidelity to high-fidelity solutions.
summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately learns solution operators across different resolutions and fidelities, producing uncertainty estimates that reflect model confidence even with limited high-fidelity data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on 1D advection, Burgers' equation, and 2D Darcy flow demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.

title: Stable spectral neural operator for learning stiff PDE systems from limited data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的稳定谱神经算子（SSNO）能够从有限数据中高效学习刚性偏微分方程系统，其数据效率和泛化能力可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on learning stiff PDE dynamics from limited data without explicit physics knowledge.

summary_zh.motivation: 从有限数据中学习刚性偏微分方程系统，克服数据稀疏和长时间预测难题。
summary_zh.method: 提出稳定谱神经算子（SSNO），嵌入谱结构并采用积分因子时间步进方案。
summary_zh.result: 在多个2D/3D基准上预测误差比领先模型低1-2个数量级，仅需2-5条训练轨迹。
summary_zh.validation: 在笛卡尔和球面几何的数值基准上验证，包括刚性和非刚性PDE系统。

summary_en.motivation: To accurately model stiff spatiotemporal dynamics from limited observational data without known governing equations.
summary_en.method: Introduces the Stable Spectral Neural Operator (SSNO) with spectrally inspired inductive biases and an integrating factor time-stepping scheme to handle stiffness.
summary_en.result: SSNO achieves one to two orders of magnitude lower prediction errors than leading models on 2D and 3D benchmarks, requiring only 2-5 training trajectories for robust generalization.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of stiff and non-stiff PDEs in Cartesian and spherical geometries.

title: R^2-HGP: A Double-Regularized Gaussian Process for Heterogeneous Transfer Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的双正则化高斯过程框架能够处理异构输入空间并融合物理信息，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics; validation is on engineering case studies, not biomedical or structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决异构输入空间下多源迁移学习中的负迁移和物理信息缺失问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出双正则化异构高斯过程框架，结合可训练先验映射、稀疏迁移系数和物理正则化。
summary_zh.result: 在仿真和工程案例中优于现有基准，有效抑制负迁移并利用物理知识。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值仿真和实际工程案例验证，对比多种评价指标。

summary_en.motivation: To address negative transfer and lack of physical knowledge in heterogeneous multi-source transfer learning with Gaussian processes.
summary_en.method: Proposes a double-regularized heterogeneous Gaussian process framework integrating a trainable prior mapping, sparse transfer coefficients, and physical regularization via a CVAE-based structure.
summary_en.result: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks in simulations and real-world engineering case studies, effectively suppressing negative transfer and leveraging physical insights.
summary_en.validation: Validated through extensive numerical simulations and two real-world engineering case studies with multiple evaluation metrics.

title: Physics-informed Polynomial Chaos Expansion with Enhanced Constrained Optimization Solver and D-optimal Sampling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息多项式混沌展开方法直接解决了高维参数空间下的约束代理建模和不确定性量化问题，可迁移至植入物生物力学设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not include application to implant biomechanics or experimental validation on biomedical problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升物理信息多项式混沌展开在高维参数空间下的计算效率和稳定性
summary_zh.method: 采用SULM约束求解器和D-optimal采样策略增强PC$^2$框架
summary_zh.result: 增强PC$^2$在高维不确定量化任务中综合性能优于标准PC$^2$
summary_zh.validation: 通过常微分和偏微分方程数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the computational efficiency and stability of physics-informed polynomial chaos expansions in high-dimensional parameter spaces under limited data.
summary_en.method: Two complementary enhancements are proposed: a numerically efficient constrained optimization solver (SULM) and a D-optimal sampling strategy for virtual point selection.
summary_en.result: The enhanced PC$^2$ framework demonstrates superior comprehensive capability over standard PC$^2$ for high-dimensional uncertainty quantification tasks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples of representative physical systems governed by ODEs/PDEs are used to evaluate the proposed methods.

title: In-Context Multi-Objective Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于Transformer的多目标优化策略，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on any FEA or biomechanics design problem, nor does it handle constraints or uncertainty quantification explicitly.

summary_zh.motivation: 多目标贝叶斯优化需针对每个问题定制代理和采集函数，且计算开销大。
summary_zh.method: 提出TAMO，使用Transformer架构预训练通用策略，通过强化学习最大化超体积改进。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和实际任务中，TAMO将提议时间减少50-1000倍，同时保持或提升Pareto前沿质量。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准多目标优化基准上测试，并与多种基线方法比较。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization requires per-task surrogate and acquisition function design, which is costly and not transferable.
summary_en.method: TAMO employs a transformer architecture pretrained via reinforcement learning to maximize cumulative hypervolume improvement, enabling in-context multi-objective optimization without retraining.
summary_en.result: TAMO reduces proposal time by 50-1000x while matching or improving Pareto front quality across synthetic and real benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on standard multi-objective optimization benchmarks and compared against several baselines.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Comparison of multi-objective optimization workflows. (Top right) tamo is fully amortized : a dimension-agnostic transformer policy is trained once, offline, on diverse synthetic tasks, and at deployment maps the history to the next query in a single forward pass.

title: Deep Learning-based Surrogate Model of Subject-Specific Finite-Element Analysis for Vertebrae.
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对生物力学有限元代理建模，方法可迁移至植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not address implant stress shielding or contact mechanics; focuses on vertebrae rather than hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决椎体有限元分析耗时长的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出集成形状编码与双解码分支的深度学习代理模型
summary_zh.result: 预测应力MAE为0.0596 MPa，R²=0.864，速度提升40倍
summary_zh.validation: 基于3960个合成椎体数据与独立测试集验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate subject-specific finite-element analysis of vertebral biomechanics for clinical use.
summary_en.method: A deep learning surrogate model with shape encoding and separate decoding branches for surface and internal nodes, trained on 3,960 synthetic vertebrae.
summary_en.result: Achieved mean absolute error of 0.0596 MPa and R² of 0.864 for von Mises stress, reducing processing time from 90-120 min to 134-154 s.
summary_en.validation: Validated on independent test samples from synthetic data generated via augmentation of 42 real CT scans.

title: 3D Printing-Neural Network Co-modelling for Personalized Biomechanical Design in Total Hip Arthroplasty
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对全髋关节置换术中的应力遮挡问题，提出了结合3D打印和神经网络的个性化生物力学设计框架，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not report micromotion values or contact/friction modeling at the bone-implant interface, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur stress distributions in Gruen zones.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决全髋关节置换术后应力遮挡和假体松动问题，实现个性化设计。
summary_zh.method: 提出3D打印-神经网络协同建模框架，基于参数化模型和DIC实验数据训练双向预测网络。
summary_zh.result: 正向网络预测应力分布R²=0.89，逆向网络推断骨质量与DXA相关性r=0.87。
summary_zh.validation: 通过42例回顾性临床病例验证框架指导个性化假体选择的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To address stress shielding and aseptic loosening in total hip arthroplasty by enabling patient-specific biomechanical prediction and implant design optimization.
summary_en.method: A 3D printing-neural network co-modelling framework was developed, using parametric pelvis-femur models, multi-material 3D-printed biomimetic bones, and DIC experiments to train forward and inverse neural networks.
summary_en.result: The forward network predicted stress distribution with R²=0.89 and MAPE=9.2%, while the inverse network inferred bone quality with correlation r=0.87 against DXA.
summary_en.validation: The framework was validated with 42 retrospective clinical cases, successfully guiding personalized implant selection and identifying high-risk patients.

title: Predicting Time-Dependent Flow Over Complex Geometries Using Operator Networks

summary_zh.method: 使用SDF编码几何、CNN处理流历史的时变DeepONet。
summary_zh.result: 对未见形状达到约5%相对L2误差和1000倍加速，但长时预测存在误差累积。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a fast, geometry-generalizing surrogate for unsteady flow around complex shapes, bypassing expensive CFD.
summary_en.method: A time-dependent Deep Operator Network with a signed distance field trunk for geometry encoding and a CNN branch for flow history, trained on 841 high-fidelity simulations.

summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks with physics-centric rollout diagnostics including phase error and divergence norms.

title: CFO: Learning Continuous-Time PDE Dynamics via Flow-Matched Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的连续时间神经算子方法可显著提升PDE代理模型的采样效率和长期稳定性，适用于生物力学植入物设计的昂贵仿真替代。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks constraint handling and uncertainty quantification, and is demonstrated only on canonical PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子代理在长时间预测中误差累积且需均匀时间离散。
summary_zh.method: 利用流匹配直接学习PDE右侧，无需通过ODE求解器反向传播。
summary_zh.result: 在四个基准上，仅用25%不规则采样数据即超越完整数据训练的基线，误差降低87%。
summary_zh.validation: 在Lorenz、Burgers、扩散反应和浅水方程上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operator surrogates suffer from error accumulation in long rollouts and require uniform temporal discretization.
summary_en.method: The Continuous Flow Operator (CFO) repurposes flow matching to directly learn the right-hand side of PDEs without backpropagating through ODE solvers.
summary_en.result: CFO achieves up to 87% relative error reduction on four benchmarks using only 25% of irregularly subsampled time points compared to autoregressive baselines trained on full data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Lorenz, 1D Burgers, 2D diffusion-reaction, and 2D shallow water equations.

summary_en.motivation: To improve prediction accuracy and sampling efficiency of surrogate models for parametric transient Darcy flows in heterogeneous porous media.
summary_en.method: A discrete neural operator integrating temporal encoding, operator learning, and UNet is proposed, along with a generative latent space adaptive sampling method using Gaussian mixture model for error density estimation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves higher prediction accuracy than the state-of-the-art attention-residual-UNet structure with limited training data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is conducted on 2D/3D single- and two-phase Darcy flow field prediction test cases.

title: Operator Learning at Machine Precision
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的算子学习方法能够达到机器精度，且适用于多种非线性PDE问题，对生物力学FEA替代建模具有高度可迁移性。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it address constraints or uncertainty quantification in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子学习方法精度不足，难以达到机器精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出CHONKNORIS，通过回归Tikhonov正则化Newton-Kantorovich更新的Cholesky因子实现机器精度。
summary_zh.result: 在多个非线性正反问题中达到机器精度，并引入基础模型FONKNORIS。
summary_zh.validation: 在非线性椭圆方程、Burgers方程、Darcy流等基准问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operator methods fail to achieve machine precision, limiting their reliability for scientific computing.
summary_en.method: CHONKNORIS regresses the Cholesky factors of the elliptic operator from Tikhonov-regularized Newton-Kantorovich updates, forming a contractive iterative architecture.
summary_en.result: The method achieves machine precision on multiple nonlinear forward and inverse PDE problems, and the foundation model FONKNORIS generalizes to unseen PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark problems including nonlinear elliptic, Burgers, Darcy flow, Calderón, inverse wave scattering, and seismic imaging.

title: SAOT: An Enhanced Locality-Aware Spectral Transformer for Solving PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的谱注意力算子变压器（SAOT）通过小波注意力增强局部特征学习，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，提高复杂植入物设计的仿真效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有傅里叶神经算子无法捕捉局部细节和高频成分，导致过平滑解。
summary_zh.method: 提出小波注意力模块与傅里叶注意力融合的谱注意力算子变压器（SAOT）。
summary_zh.result: 在六个算子学习基准上达到最先进性能，并具有离散化不变性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准数据集上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Fourier Neural Operators suffer from over-smoothing and inability to capture local details and high-frequency components in PDE solutions.
summary_en.method: A hybrid spectral Transformer framework, SAOT, integrates wavelet attention for locality-aware features with Fourier-based attention for global receptive field via a gated fusion block.
summary_en.result: SAOT achieves state-of-the-art performance on six operator learning benchmarks and demonstrates strong discretization-invariant ability.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE datasets (e.g., Darcy flow, Navier-Stokes) are used to evaluate accuracy and generalization.

title: Reduced-Basis Deep Operator Learning for Parametric PDEs with Independently Varying Boundary and Source Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的RB-DeepONet方法可显著加速参数化PDE求解，其标签无关训练和严格误差控制对生物力学代理建模具有高度可迁移性。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, and lacks experimental validation in a physical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子学习方法在处理独立变化的边界和源项时效率低且缺乏可解释性。
summary_zh.method: 融合降阶基与DeepONet架构，通过贪婪算法构建可解释的截断空间，并采用投影变分残差进行无标签训练。
summary_zh.result: 在保持精度的同时大幅减少可训练参数，实现显著加速。

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods struggle with independently varying boundary and source data, lacking interpretability and requiring extensive labeled data.
summary_en.method: RB-DeepONet integrates a reduced-basis space into the DeepONet trunk, uses Greedy selection for interpretability, and trains the branch network label-free via a projected variational residual targeting the RB-Galerkin solution.
summary_en.result: The method achieves accuracy competitive with intrusive RB-Galerkin and other operator learners while using dramatically fewer trainable parameters and achieving significant speedups.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on parametric PDEs with varying boundary and source data demonstrate accuracy and efficiency compared to POD-DeepONet, FEONet, and intrusive RB-Galerkin.

title: A Physics Informed Machine Learning Framework for Optimal Sensor Placement and Parameter Estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN框架用于最优传感器布置和参数估计，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模和不确定性量化。

summary_zh.result: 在反应-扩散-对流问题中，该方法比直觉或随机传感器布置的参数估计精度更高

summary_en.motivation: To address the gap in understanding how sensor placement affects the performance of Physics-Informed Neural Networks for parameter estimation in distributed-parameter systems.
summary_en.method: A PINN-based framework is introduced that treats unknown parameters as additional inputs, enabling efficient computation of sensitivity functions via automatic differentiation and optimal sensor placement using the D-optimality criterion.
summary_en.result: The proposed method consistently achieves higher accuracy in parameter estimation compared to intuitively or randomly selected sensor positions on two reaction-diffusion-advection problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two numerical simulation cases of increasing complexity, demonstrating the effectiveness of the framework.

title: Real-time distortion prediction in metallic additive manufacturing via a physics-informed neural operator approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决实时预测问题。

summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息深度算子网络-循环神经网络(PIDeepONet-RNN)，融合热传导方程作为软约束。
summary_zh.result: 模型在z和y方向最大绝对误差分别为0.9733 mm和0.2049 mm，误差集中在熔池区域。

summary_en.motivation: Real-time distortion prediction is critical for defect control in metal additive manufacturing, but numerical simulations are computationally expensive and conventional ML models fail to capture spatiotemporal features.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural operator (PIDeepONet-RNN) is proposed, incorporating the heat conduction equation as a soft constraint to decouple thermo-mechanical fields and map thermal history to distortion.
summary_en.result: The model achieves high accuracy with max absolute errors of 0.9733 mm (z-direction) and 0.2049 mm (y-direction), with errors concentrated in the molten pool region.
summary_en.validation: The model is trained and tested on datasets generated from experimentally validated finite element simulations.

summary_en.motivation: Ensemble-based uncertainty propagation in digital twins is computationally prohibitive, especially when embedded in control loops.
summary_en.method: A filtered Neural Galerkin reduced model is introduced that evolves the mean and covariance of the reduced solution distribution via moment closure, eliminating the need for an ensemble.
summary_en.result: The proposed scheme achieves over an order of magnitude speedup compared to ensemble-based uncertainty propagation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark problems demonstrate accuracy and computational gains.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有GNN代理模型多用于流体，缺乏对结构动力学问题的研究。
summary_zh.method: 提出GNSS框架，采用局部坐标系、符号感知损失和波长感知连接半径。
summary_zh.result: 在梁的脉冲激励案例中，GNSS准确预测数百时间步，泛化到未见载荷，速度远超有限元。

summary_en.motivation: Graph neural network surrogate models have been extensively applied to fluid dynamics but rarely to structural dynamics, motivating a dedicated framework.
summary_en.method: GNSS adopts an encode-process-decode paradigm with node-fixed local frames, sign-aware regression loss, and wavelength-informed connectivity radius.
summary_en.result: On a beam excited by a 50kHz Hanning pulse, GNSS accurately reproduces physics over hundreds of timesteps and generalizes to unseen loads, outperforming existing GNNs.
summary_en.validation: Validation against explicit finite element baselines demonstrates substantial inference speedups while preserving spatial and temporal fidelity.

title: Uncertainty quantification in model discovery by distilling interpretable material constitutive models from Gaussian process posteriors
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不确定性量化框架可直接迁移至生物力学代理模型中的材料本构发现与参数不确定性评估。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有本构模型发现方法缺乏灵活的不确定性量化，且受限于先验选择或线性系数。
summary_zh.method: 提出部分贝叶斯框架，结合高斯过程、归一化流和Sobol敏感性分析进行模型发现与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 在各项同性和实验各向异性数据上成功发现稀疏且可解释的本构模型。

summary_en.motivation: Existing methods for constitutive model discovery lack flexible uncertainty quantification and are limited by prior selection or linear coefficient assumptions.
summary_en.method: A partially Bayesian framework is proposed that augments stress-deformation data with a Gaussian process, approximates parameter distributions via normalizing flows, and distills them by matching function distributions, followed by Sobol sensitivity analysis for sparsity.
summary_en.result: The framework successfully discovers sparse and interpretable constitutive models for both isotropic and experimental anisotropic data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and experimental anisotropic data.

title: Physically consistent and uncertainty-aware learning of spatiotemporal dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理一致神经算子（PCNO）和不确定性量化方法（DiffPCNO）可直接迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决昂贵仿真采样效率与约束处理问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有机器学习方法忽略物理定律且无法量化时空预测的不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理一致神经算子（PCNO）和扩散模型增强版（DiffPCNO），在傅里叶空间投影满足守恒律。
summary_zh.result: 在湍流、洪水、大气预报中实现高保真、物理一致且带不确定性的预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值仿真案例（湍流、洪水、大气）验证预测精度与物理一致性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing machine learning methods for spatiotemporal dynamics neglect physical laws and fail to quantify prediction uncertainty.
summary_en.method: A physics-consistent neural operator (PCNO) enforces conservation laws via a projection layer in Fourier space, and a diffusion model-enhanced variant (DiffPCNO) quantifies uncertainty using a consistency model.
summary_en.result: PCNO and DiffPCNO achieve high-fidelity, physically consistent, and uncertainty-aware forecasts across turbulent flow, flood, and atmospheric systems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical simulation cases including turbulent flow, flood modeling, and atmospheric forecasting.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测组织动力学的噪声多细胞行为，用于生物工程数字孪生。
summary_zh.method: 结合图神经网络、归一化流和WaveNet的生成模型，将组织表示为神经随机微分方程。
summary_zh.result: 模型捕捉随机细胞运动并预测细胞状态演化，准确生成实验动力学。
summary_zh.validation: 通过上皮组织实验和果蝇翅膀发育系统验证。

summary_en.motivation: To predict noisy multicellular dynamics in tissues for digital twin applications in bioengineering.
summary_en.method: A generative model combining graph neural networks, normalizing flows, and WaveNet to represent tissues as neural stochastic differential equations with a dual signaling graph.
summary_en.result: The model captures stochastic cell motion, predicts cell state evolution, and accurately generates experimental dynamics of developmental systems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on epithelial tissue experiments and fly wing development, including stochastic ERK waves.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及多孔钛合金支架的LPBF制造、力学性能匹配和应力遮挡缓解，与用户研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not report fatigue testing, surface roughness, or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有3D打印多孔钛合金支架各向同性且结构简单，无法模拟天然骨的各向异性。
summary_zh.method: 设计梯度晶格结构，通过FEA优化弹性模量匹配，CFD模拟流体动力学，并施加振荡流体流动促进成骨分化。
summary_zh.result: 梯度晶格支架缓解应力遮挡，优化间质液流动，促进BMSCs成骨分化和血管化。
summary_zh.validation: FEA和CFD仿真验证力学和流体性能，体外细胞实验验证成骨和血管化效果。

summary_en.motivation: Existing 3D-printed porous titanium alloy scaffolds exhibit isotropic mechanical behavior and simple through-hole structures that fail to replicate the anisotropic properties of natural bone.
summary_en.method: A gradient lattice scaffold was designed and optimized via FEA for elastic modulus matching and CFD for fluid dynamics, and oscillatory fluid flow was applied to enhance osteogenic differentiation.
summary_en.result: The gradient lattice scaffold mitigated stress shielding, optimized interstitial fluid flow, and promoted BMSC osteogenic differentiation and vascularization.
summary_en.validation: FEA and CFD simulations validated mechanical and fluid performance, while in vitro cell experiments confirmed osteogenesis and vascularization.

title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Graph Neural Networks and Physics Informed Learning for Surrogate Modelling of Finite Element Analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接评估了GNN和PINN作为FEA替代模型的方法，并考虑了约束（物理定律）和不确定性（通过PINN提高泛化），方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the surrogate model to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification beyond generalization error.

summary_zh.motivation: FEA计算昂贵，需要高精度替代模型加速设计优化。
summary_zh.method: 系统评估GNN和3D U-Net作为FEA替代模型，并引入基于Navier Cauchy方程的PINN框架和课程学习策略。
summary_zh.result: GNN优于U-Net，MPNN PINN在精度、模型大小和推理速度间取得最佳平衡。
summary_zh.validation: 在参数化I梁的FEA数据集上对比相对L2误差。

summary_en.motivation: Finite Element Analysis is computationally expensive, necessitating accurate surrogate models for design optimization.
summary_en.method: This paper systematically evaluates graph neural networks and 3D U-Nets as surrogates for FEA of parametric I-beams, incorporating a PINN framework governed by Navier Cauchy equations and a curriculum learning strategy.
summary_en.result: GNNs outperform U-Nets, with MPNN PINN offering the best trade-off among accuracy, model size, and inference speed.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on an FEA dataset of parametric I-beams by comparing relative L2 errors.

title: Tensor Gaussian Processes: Efficient Solvers for Nonlinear PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的张量高斯过程求解器可高效处理非线性PDE，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on PDE solving without biomedical application.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PDE求解器效率低或扩展性差，需高效且可扩展的替代方案。
summary_zh.method: 提出张量高斯过程（TGPS），通过一维GP因子函数与张量分解近似解，结合牛顿法与交替最小二乘高效求解非线性PDE。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准PDE上，TGPS在精度和效率上优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准测试集上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PDE solvers suffer from inefficiency or poor scalability, motivating a more efficient and scalable approach.
summary_en.method: We propose TGPS, a tensor-GP-based solver that factorizes the solution into one-dimensional GP factor functions combined via tensor decomposition, and uses Newton's method with alternating least squares for efficient nonlinear PDE solving.
summary_en.result: TGPS achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on several benchmark PDEs compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems demonstrate the method's performance.

title: LRQ-Solver: A Transformer-Based Neural Operator for Fast and Accurate Solving of Large-scale 3D PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的LRQ-Solver是一种高效的3D PDE求解器，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决大规模仿真采样效率问题。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on general 3D PDE solving (e.g., fluid dynamics, structural mechanics) without specific application to implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate modeling for hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决大规模3D PDE求解中预处理昂贵和计算开销大的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出低秩查询注意力与参数条件拉格朗日建模结合的物理集成框架
summary_zh.result: 在DrivAerNet++和3D Beam数据集上误差降低28-39%，训练加速50倍
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准数据集上验证精度和效率

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the high computational cost and expensive preprocessing in solving large-scale 3D PDEs on complex geometries.
summary_en.method: A physics-integrated neural operator combining Low-Rank Query Attention (LR-QA) and Parameter Conditioned Lagrangian Modeling (PCLM) for efficient and accurate PDE solving.
summary_en.result: Achieves 28.76% to 38.9% error reduction on standard benchmarks and up to 50x training speedup, scaling to 2 million points on a single GPU.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the DrivAerNet++ and 3D Beam numerical benchmark datasets.

title: A Constrained Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization Method
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的约束多保真贝叶斯优化方法可直接迁移到植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题，特别是处理约束和计算成本问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, and lacks validation on implant-specific problems such as stress shielding or micromotion.

summary_zh.motivation: 多保真贝叶斯优化在约束优化中难以高效识别可行域。
summary_zh.method: 提出具有解析闭式表达式的约束多保真贝叶斯优化采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成问题和两个实际工程设计中验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成测试问题和两个工程仿真案例（ICF和高电流接头）验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization faces challenges in efficiently identifying feasible regions under constraints.
summary_en.method: Novel acquisition functions with closed-form expressions are proposed for constrained multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates effectiveness on synthetic problems and two real-world engineering design problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic test problems and two engineering simulation cases (ICF and high-current joint design using finite element contact mechanics).

title: Bayesian Active Learning for Bayesian Model Updating: the Art of Acquisition Functions and Beyond
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯主动学习方法可显著提升昂贵仿真模型的采样效率，并支持不确定性量化，适用于植入物/生物力学设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant/biomechanics design, and does not handle constraints in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵仿真模型下贝叶斯模型更新中后验估计的计算效率问题
summary_zh.method: 提出四种新的采集函数，并扩展至过渡贝叶斯求积方案
summary_zh.result: 新方法在基准测试和工程实例中表现出高效率和鲁棒性
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准和工程实例验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate posteriors and model evidences in Bayesian model updating with expensive-to-evaluate models.
summary_en.method: Four novel acquisition functions are developed for Bayesian quadrature, extended to transitional BQ with refinements.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods demonstrate high efficiency and robustness in benchmark studies and an engineering example.
summary_en.validation: Validated through extensive numerical benchmarks and an engineering application.

title: Multi-level informed optimization via decomposed Kriging for large design problems under uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多层级Kriging代理模型方法可高效处理高维不确定性问题，对生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化具有直接迁移潜力。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks experimental validation in a physical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有不确定性优化方法难以扩展到高维复杂工程问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于Kriging的多层级分解代理模型，自适应更新以高效利用不确定性信息。
summary_zh.result: 在分析测试中，该方法比现有方法快数个数量级且精度更高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准分析测试问题与现有方法进行统计对比。

summary_en.motivation: Current uncertainty quantification and optimization methods are not scalable to high-dimensional and resource-intensive engineering design problems.
summary_en.method: A multi-level Kriging-based surrogate is developed using hierarchical and orthogonal decomposition to adaptively update multiple surrogates with uncertainty-informed data.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves orders of magnitude improvement in speed and accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods on analytical test problems.
summary_en.validation: Statistical comparison against state-of-the-art methods on an analytical testbed.

title: Optimizing permeability of microporous scaffolds through CFD simulation to enhance osseointegration

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对多孔支架的渗透率优化，并通过体内实验验证了骨整合效果，与用户研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not explicitly link permeability to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report fatigue testing or surface roughness/as-built morphology.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统支架设计缺乏预测骨整合的流体传输能力。
summary_zh.method: 结合CFD模拟、SLM制造和兔股骨植入实验，优化支架渗透率。
summary_zh.result: 发现最佳渗透率窗口6.99–8.82×10⁻⁸ m²，最大化骨长入和细胞粘附。
summary_zh.validation: 通过兔股骨植入模型进行体内验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional scaffold design lacks predictive power for fluid transport and bone ingrowth, necessitating a permeability-guided approach.
summary_en.method: A library of Ti6Al4V scaffolds with varied topologies was fabricated via SLM, and permeability was quantified using CFD simulations, followed by in vivo implantation in rabbit femurs.
summary_en.result: An optimal permeability window of 6.99–8.82 × 10⁻⁸ m² was identified that maximized early-stage bone ingrowth and cell adhesion.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rabbit femur implantation models validated the optimal permeability window for osseointegration.

title: Microstructure sensitive recurrent neural network surrogate model of crystal plasticity
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的微观结构敏感RNN代理模型可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多尺度模拟与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on crystal plasticity for structural materials, not on biomedical implant mechanics or bone-implant interface simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 全场晶体塑性模型计算成本高，限制其在不确定性量化和多尺度模拟中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出微观结构敏感的GRU代理模型，从三维晶粒结构预测均质化应力响应。
summary_zh.result: 模型在分布内验证和未见变形模式下误差仅2-3 MPa，但分布外微观结构预测困难。
summary_zh.validation: 基于30万组晶体塑性模拟数据，对比代理模型与全场模型的应力预测。

summary_en.motivation: Full-field crystal plasticity models are computationally expensive, limiting their use in uncertainty quantification and multiscale simulations.
summary_en.method: A microstructure-sensitive GRU surrogate model is developed to predict homogenized stress responses directly from 3D grain structures and arbitrary deformation histories.
summary_en.result: The surrogate reproduces CP predictions with errors of 2-3 MPa for in-distribution and unseen deformation modes, but struggles with out-of-distribution microstructures.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on over 300,000 CP simulations, comparing surrogate predictions to full-field model outputs for various microstructures and loading paths.

title: MaNGO - Adaptable Graph Network Simulators via Meta-Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于元学习的图网络模拟器，可快速适应不同物理参数，对解决生物力学设计中昂贵仿真的采样效率问题具有高度可迁移性。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有图网络模拟器无法快速适应不同物理参数，需重新训练且数据收集成本高。
summary_zh.method: 提出MaNGO架构，结合条件神经过程和神经算子，通过元学习学习共享潜在结构实现快速适应。
summary_zh.result: 在多种材料属性动力学预测任务上，对未见参数的预测精度接近oracle模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准动力学预测基准上对比现有GNS方法，评估泛化性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing graph network simulators require retraining for each variation in physical parameters, leading to inefficiency in data collection and computation.
summary_en.method: MaNGO combines conditional neural processes with a novel neural operator architecture to learn shared latent structures via meta-learning, enabling fast adaptation to new parameters without retraining.
summary_en.result: MaNGO achieves accuracy on unseen material properties close to that of an oracle model, outperforming existing GNS methods on multiple dynamics prediction tasks.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on several dynamics prediction benchmarks with varying material properties, comparing against standard GNS baselines.

title: A comprehensive comparison of neural operators for 3D industry-scale engineering designs
relevance_to_user: 该论文系统比较了多种神经算子架构在3D工程问题上的表现，其方法可直接迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply neural operators to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, and lacks uncertainty quantification and constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子模型选择困难，缺乏公平比较。
summary_zh.method: 标准化六个3D工程数据集，系统比较四种神经算子变体。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了各模型在预测性能、计算效率等方面的优劣。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准化工程数据集上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: The lack of fair and comprehensive comparisons makes neural operator model selection challenging for engineering design.
summary_en.method: Six standardized 3D industry-scale engineering datasets are proposed, and four types of neural operator variants are systematically compared with practical enhancements.
summary_en.result: The benchmarking study reveals each model's strengths and limitations in predictive performance, computational efficiency, memory usage, and deployment complexity.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standardized engineering datasets covering thermal, elasticity, plasticity, and fluid dynamics problems.

title: Strain shielding effect analysis of solid and porous Ti-6Al-4V alloy implanted femur bone using finite element analysis.

why_not_core: This paper uses FEA only, without LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or surface characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析多孔钛合金植入物对股骨应变遮挡的影响，以减少无菌性松动。
summary_zh.method: 使用有限元分析比较实心和多孔植入物在三种载荷下的应变分布。
summary_zh.result: 多孔植入物在站立和行走时增加骨应变，但在爬楼梯时减少应变，表明可降低应力遮挡。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过有限元仿真，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of porous Ti-6Al-4V implants on strain shielding in the femur to reduce aseptic loosening.
summary_en.method: Finite element analysis was used to compare strain distributions in solid and porous implanted femurs under standing, walking, and stair climbing loads.
summary_en.result: Porous implants increased bone strains by 31% and 24.3% during standing and walking, but reduced strains by 12.18% during stair climbing, indicating reduced stress shielding.
summary_en.validation: The study is purely computational with no experimental validation.

title: Does the ratio of stem-to-femur length matter? A validated finite element analysis.

why_not_core: This paper does not include patient-specific clinical outcomes or long-term follow-up data.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究股骨长度与假体柄长度比例对初始稳定性和应力遮挡的影响。
summary_zh.method: 基于100例CT重建股骨，设计13种个性化柄长，建立1300个有限元模型并实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To determine the optimal ratio of stem length to femur length that minimizes micromotion and stress shielding in cementless hip implants.
summary_en.method: A validated finite element analysis was performed on 100 patient-specific femora with 13 stem lengths each, totaling 1300 models, under standardized loading.
summary_en.result: The optimal stem length was found to be 18.5% ± 2.7% of femur length, balancing primary stability and proximal stress shielding.
summary_en.validation: The finite element model was validated against cadaveric experiments using digital image correlation under static loading.

why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统实心髋关节植入物存在应力遮挡风险，需要设计多孔结构以匹配骨刚度。
summary_zh.method: 采用浮动投影拓扑优化算法，结合多约束和有限元-肌肉骨骼建模，设计多孔髋关节植入物。
summary_zh.result: 优化后的植入物刚度降低，应力遮挡减轻，且边界光滑无需后处理。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元分析在不同载荷工况下验证植入物性能。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional solid hip implants cause stress shielding, necessitating porous designs with tailored stiffness.
summary_en.method: A Floating Projection Topology Optimization (FPTO) algorithm with ersatz material model and multiple constraints is used to design porous hip implants, integrated with finite-element-musculoskeletal modeling.
summary_en.result: The optimized implant achieves lower stiffness, reduced stress shielding, and smooth boundaries without post-processing.
summary_en.validation: Finite element analysis under multiple loading cases validates the biomechanical performance of the porous implant design.

title: From Cheap Geometry to Expensive Physics: Elevating Neural Operators via Latent Shape Pretraining
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种利用无标签几何数据预训练来提升神经算子数据效率的方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用大量无标签几何数据提升神经算子在有限物理标签下的预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 两阶段框架：先自编码器几何重建预训练，再以预训练潜变量作为神经算子输入进行监督学习。
summary_zh.result: 在四个PDE数据集上，相比直接输入点云，该方法一致提高了预测精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上对比多种Transformer神经算子。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the data efficiency of neural operators for PDE solution prediction by leveraging abundant unlabeled geometry data.
summary_en.method: A two-stage framework where an autoencoder is first pretrained on geometry reconstruction, then the latent embeddings are used as inputs to train a neural operator supervised on PDE solutions.
summary_en.result: The proposed pretraining strategy consistently improves prediction accuracy across four PDE datasets and three transformer-based neural operators.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE datasets comparing against models trained directly on raw point clouds.

title: Differentiable Autoencoding Neural Operator for Interpretable and Integrable Latent Space Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的可微自编码神经算子框架能够学习可解释的潜在空间，并集成可微PDE求解器，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design optimization, nor does it handle constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现物理可解释的潜在空间表示与高效计算代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出可微自编码神经算子，在潜在空间中嵌入可微PDE求解器进行端到端训练。
summary_zh.result: 在2D/3D流动问题中准确重建高保真时空场，潜在结构具有物理意义。
summary_zh.validation: 通过2D圆柱绕流、2D狭窄动脉和3D患者特异性冠状动脉案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve physically interpretable latent representations and computationally efficient surrogates for high-dimensional spatiotemporal data.
summary_en.method: Proposes a differentiable autoencoding neural operator that embeds a differentiable PDE solver in the latent space for end-to-end training.
summary_en.result: Accurate reconstruction of high-fidelity spatiotemporal fields with meaningful latent structures on 2D/3D flow benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 2D flow past cylinder, 2D stenosed artery, and 3D patient-specific coronary artery simulations.

title: Deep set based operator learning with uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的UQ-SONet框架能够处理稀疏和可变传感器位置的算子学习，并内置不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it include any FEA validation or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子学习方法需要固定传感器位置且缺乏不确定性量化，限制了实际应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出UQ-SONet，结合集合变换器嵌入和条件变分自编码器，实现置换不变且带不确定性量化的算子学习。
summary_zh.result: 在确定性和随机PDE（包括Navier-Stokes方程）上验证了鲁棒性和有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试（确定性/随机PDE）验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods require fixed sensor locations and lack uncertainty quantification, limiting their practical applicability.
summary_en.method: UQ-SONet integrates a set transformer embedding for sparse and variable sensor locations with a conditional variational autoencoder to approximate the conditional distribution of the solution operator.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on deterministic and stochastic PDEs, including Navier-Stokes, demonstrate robustness and effectiveness.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of deterministic and stochastic PDEs.

title: Learning to Solve Optimization Problems Constrained with Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合神经算子和代理优化器的学习框架，用于求解PDE约束优化问题，其方法可迁移至植入物设计中的FEA代理建模和约束优化。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: PDE约束优化问题计算成本高，需高效求解方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出动态预测器（时间离散神经算子）与优化代理器（代理优化器）的双网络框架。
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers方程、热方程等基准任务上，解质量与经典方法相当，计算速度提升四个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE约束优化基准任务上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: PDE-constrained optimization problems are computationally expensive due to high-dimensional discretization and dynamic constraints.
summary_en.method: A dual-network framework combining a time-discrete neural operator for approximating PDE dynamics and a proxy optimizer for approximating optimal decisions.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves solution quality comparable to classical control-based algorithms while providing up to four orders of magnitude speedup.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark PDE-constrained optimization tasks including Burgers' equation, heat equation, and voltage regulation.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了LPBF制造的钛合金点阵结构骨植入物，包括力学性能、刚度匹配和生物相容性，与用户研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not report fatigue testing, surface roughness, or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用LPBF制造点阵结构钛植入物，实现刚度匹配和骨整合。
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF制备Cp-Ti和Ti6Al4V gyroid点阵，结合Timoshenko梁理论和Gibson-Ashby模型分析力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 点阵结构弹性模量显著降低，Timoshenko理论更符合实验数据；PLA/CaP涂层促进细胞增殖。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和体外细胞实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop lattice-structured titanium bone implants via LPBF that mimic bone's mechanical properties and enhance osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Gyroid lattice structures of Cp-Ti and Ti6Al4V were fabricated by LPBF and analyzed using Timoshenko beam theory and Gibson-Ashby model.
summary_en.result: The elastic modulus was significantly reduced, with Timoshenko theory better matching experimental data; PLA/CaP coating improved cell adhesion and proliferation.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and in-vitro cell studies were conducted.

title: GeoFunFlow: Geometric Function Flow Matching for Inverse Operator Learning over Complex Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在复杂几何上进行逆问题求解的几何扩散模型，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂几何上PDE逆问题的高计算成本与不适定性
summary_zh.method: 结合几何函数自编码器与潜空间扩散模型进行逆问题求解
summary_zh.result: 在五个基准上实现最先进的重建精度与校准的不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上对比算子学习与扩散模型基线

summary_en.motivation: Inverse PDE problems on complex geometries are computationally expensive and ill-posed, requiring efficient and scalable methods.
summary_en.method: GeoFunFlow combines a geometric function autoencoder with a latent diffusion model trained via rectified flow to enable posterior sampling from sparse and noisy data.
summary_en.result: The method achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy and calibrated uncertainty quantification across five benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks comparing against operator-learning and diffusion model baselines.

title: Multimodal Neural Operators for Real-Time Biomechanical Modelling of Traumatic Brain Injury
relevance_to_user: 该论文将神经算子应用于生物力学建模，其多模态融合方法可直接迁移到植入物设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on brain biomechanics and traumatic brain injury, not on implant design, stress shielding, or hip biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 脑损伤建模中有限元求解器计算成本高，需要快速替代模型。
summary_zh.method: 采用多模态神经算子（FNO、DeepONet等）融合影像与标量数据预测全脑位移。
summary_zh.result: DeepONet在实部位移场预测中达到90%准确率，推理速度远超有限元。
summary_zh.validation: 基于249个体内MRE数据集进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Finite element solvers for traumatic brain injury modeling are too computationally expensive for clinical use, motivating the development of fast surrogate models.
summary_en.method: Multimodal neural operator architectures (FNO, Factorized FNO, Multi-Grid FNO, DeepONet) are evaluated for fusing volumetric neuroimaging, demographic parameters, and acquisition metadata to predict full-field brain displacement.
summary_en.result: DeepONet achieves the highest accuracy on real displacement fields (MSE=0.0039, 90.0% accuracy) with the fastest inference speed (3.83 it/s) and fewest parameters (2.09M).
summary_en.validation: Models are validated on 249 in vivo MRE datasets across frequencies from 20 to 90 Hz, comparing predicted displacement fields against ground truth.

summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF制备支架并进行静态和动态力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 支架具有优异的力学性能和长期稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证支架性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical properties and long-term stability of porous titanium scaffolds with rhombic dodecahedron structures.
summary_en.method: Scaffolds were fabricated by LPBF and subjected to static and dynamic mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The scaffolds exhibited excellent mechanical properties and long-term stability.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing including compression and fatigue.

title: GenUQ: Predictive Uncertainty Estimates via Generative Hyper-Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需似然函数的生成式超网络不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性估计。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子学习的不确定性量化方法依赖似然函数，难以处理随机算子。
summary_zh.method: 提出GenUQ，使用生成式超网络从观测数据中学习参数分布，避免构造似然。
summary_zh.result: 在三个算例中优于其他UQ方法，包括随机椭圆PDE和材料失效建模。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准问题（制造算子、随机PDE、多孔钢失效）验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing uncertainty quantification methods for operator learning rely on likelihood-based inference, which is infeasible for stochastic operators.
summary_en.method: GenUQ introduces a generative hyper-network that learns parameter distributions consistent with observed data without constructing a likelihood.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms other UQ approaches on three benchmark problems, including a manufactured operator, a stochastic elliptic PDE, and porous steel failure modeling.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks: a manufactured operator, a stochastic elliptic PDE, and a porous steel tension failure problem.

title: Decoupled-Value Attention for Prior-Data Fitted Networks: GP Inference for Physical Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的PFN注意力机制，可加速高斯过程推理，适用于高维物理方程代理建模，对生物力学FEA代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速高斯过程推理，用于物理系统快速代理建模
summary_zh.method: 提出解耦值注意力机制，仅从输入计算相似度，标签通过值传播
summary_zh.result: 在高维回归任务中验证损失降低50%以上，速度比精确GP快80倍
summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数和64维电力潮流方程上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate Gaussian process inference for fast surrogate modeling of physical systems by improving prior-data fitted networks.
summary_en.method: Proposes Decoupled-Value Attention (DVA) that computes similarities from inputs only and propagates labels through values, mimicking GP update without kernels.
summary_en.result: DVA reduces validation loss by over 50% in high-dimensional regression and achieves 80x speedup over exact GP inference on 64D power flow equations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and a 64-dimensional power flow equation.

title: Geometric Autoencoder Priors for Bayesian Inversion: Learn First Observe Later
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的几何感知贝叶斯反演框架可迁移至植入物力学代理建模中的不确定性量化与几何约束优化。
why_not_core: Does not apply to implant/biomechanics design; tested only on fluid/heat/Helmholtz problems, no biomedical or solid-mechanics FEA validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 工程中从稀疏观测反演全场信息是高度病态的，需利用多系统信息。
summary_zh.method: 提出几何自编码器贝叶斯反演框架，学习几何感知生成模型作为先验。
summary_zh.result: 在热传导、空气动力学等复杂几何问题上预测精度与监督学习相当，UQ校准良好。
summary_zh.validation: 在矩形热传导、翼型RANS、3D车身亥姆霍兹等数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Recovering full-field physical information from sparse noisy observations is highly ill-posed, motivating the use of shared information across multiple systems with varying geometries.
summary_en.method: We propose Geometric Autoencoders for Bayesian Inversion (GABI), a framework that learns geometry-conditioned generative priors via autoencoders and performs Bayesian inversion with Approximate Bayesian Computation sampling.
summary_en.result: GABI achieves predictive accuracy comparable to supervised learning while providing well-calibrated uncertainty quantification on challenging problems with complex geometries.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on four numerical benchmarks: steady-state heat conduction, RANS flow around airfoils, Helmholtz resonance on 3D car bodies, and RANS airflow over terrain.

title: Evaluation of biomechanical properties and early osseointegration of biomimetic bone trabecular Ti6Al4V scaffolds based on Voronoi design
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了基于Voronoi设计的Ti6Al4V多孔支架的力学性能与早期骨整合，与用户关于AM生物医学材料的方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing or detailed surface roughness/as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现骨整合增强与力学匹配的兼顾是骨支架设计的关键挑战。
summary_zh.method: 采用Voronoi设计结合SLM制备Ti6Al4V多孔支架，并进行压缩测试和兔股骨髁缺损模型体内实验。
summary_zh.result: Voronoi支架的弹性模量和屈服强度与松质骨匹配，骨整合能力优于传统支柱和TPMS结构。

summary_en.motivation: Achieving concurrent enhancement of osseointegration and mechanical compatibility with native cancellous bone remains a critical design constraint for porous scaffolds.
summary_en.method: A Voronoi-tessellated porous Ti6Al4V scaffold was fabricated via selective laser melting, and its mechanical properties and early in vivo osseointegration were evaluated using compression testing, CFD, and a rabbit femoral condyle defect model.
summary_en.result: The Voronoi scaffold exhibited cancellous bone-matching elastic modulus and yield strength, mitigating stress shielding, and demonstrated significantly enhanced osteogenic potential and bone-implant integration compared to strut-based and TPMS designs.
summary_en.validation: Validation included mechanical compression testing, computational fluid dynamics, and in vivo histomorphometry and micro-CT at 4 and 12 weeks in a rabbit model.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子缺乏函数输出的有限样本覆盖保证。
summary_zh.method: 将分裂保形预测扩展到函数空间，通过离散化映射和渐近收敛实现。
summary_zh.result: 方法在分辨率变化下保持校准覆盖，超分辨率任务中覆盖更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证覆盖率和分辨率鲁棒性。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators lack finite-sample coverage guarantees for functional outputs, limiting their reliability in uncertainty-critical applications.
summary_en.method: Extends split conformal prediction to function spaces via a discretization map and asymptotic convergence analysis, with a regression-based correction for resolution transfer.
summary_en.result: The proposed method maintains calibrated coverage with less variation under resolution shifts and achieves better coverage in super-resolution tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks (e.g., Darcy flow, advection-diffusion) demonstrating coverage and robustness to resolution changes.

title: Autoencoder-based non-intrusive model order reduction in continuum mechanics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的非侵入式降阶建模框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型构建，解决高成本仿真采样效率问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific geometry; it focuses on general continuum mechanics benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低连续介质力学中高维有限元仿真的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 结合自编码器降维与回归网络映射参数到潜码，构建端到端代理模型
summary_zh.result: 在非线性复合材料、各向异性弹性及热力耦合问题上实现高精度全场解重构
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个非线性基准算例验证代理模型精度

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of high-dimensional finite element simulations in continuum mechanics.
summary_en.method: An autoencoder compresses high-dimensional FE solutions into a latent space, and a regression network maps parameters to latent codes, forming an end-to-end surrogate.
summary_en.result: Accurate full-field reconstructions are achieved on nonlinear benchmarks including heterogeneous composites, anisotropic elasticity, and thermo-mechanical coupling.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple nonlinear benchmark problems with comparison to high-fidelity solutions.

title: RAMS: Residual-based adversarial-gradient moving sample method for scientific machine learning in solving partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应采样方法可显著提高PINN和神经算子的训练效率，适用于高维PDE和算子学习，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有采样方法在高维PDE和算子学习中计算成本高，需高效自适应采样。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于残差的对抗梯度移动采样方法，沿对抗梯度方向移动样本以最大化残差。
summary_zh.result: 在多种高维PDE和算子学习任务中验证了方法的有效性，首次实现算子学习的自适应采样。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试（高维PDE、物理信息及数据驱动算子学习）验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing adaptive sampling methods for PINNs and neural operators are computationally expensive for high-dimensional problems, motivating a more efficient approach.
summary_en.method: The proposed RAMS method moves training samples along adversarial gradient directions to maximize PDE residuals via gradient-based optimization.
summary_en.result: Extensive experiments on high-dimensional PDEs and operator learning tasks demonstrate that RAMS significantly improves training efficiency and accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including high-dimensional PDEs and both physics-informed and data-driven operator learning problems.

title: MD-PNOP: Equation-Recast Neural Operators for Minimal-Data Extrapolation and PDE Solver Acceleration
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的MD-PNOP框架通过方程重构实现神经算子参数外推，可显著加速参数化PDE求解，其方法可直接迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on neutron transport rather than solid mechanics or biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PDE数值求解器在大规模参数研究中计算开销大，需加速。
summary_zh.method: 提出MD-PNOP框架，将参数诱导的算子差异重构为源项，利用预训练神经算子提供初值加速迭代求解。
summary_zh.result: 在单参数训练下实现多参数外推，计算时间减少约50%且保持全阶精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在玻尔兹曼输运方程求解器上验证，涵盖多种参数分布和特征值问题。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional numerical PDE solvers suffer from high computational cost in large-scale parametric studies, motivating the need for acceleration.
summary_en.method: The MD-PNOP framework recasts parameter-induced operator differences as additional source terms and uses a pretrained neural operator to provide improved initial guesses for iterative solvers.
summary_en.result: Neural operators trained on a single parameter set successfully extrapolate to heterogeneous, sinusoidal, and discontinuous parameter distributions, achieving approximately 50% reduction in computational time while maintaining full-order fidelity.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on Boltzmann transport equation solvers for fixed-source, single-group eigenvalue, and multigroup coupled eigenvalue problems.

title: Integrating Decision Trees and Clustering for Efficient Optimization of Bioink Rheology and 3D Bioprinted Construct Microenvironments.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Manufacturing and Mechanical Engineering Technology, Rochester Institute of Technology, 70 Lomb Memorial Dr., Rochester, NY 14623.

relevance_to_user: 该论文将决策树和聚类集成到生物打印工作流中，用于优化生物墨水流变性和支架微环境，直接契合AI驱动生物打印的研究方向。
why_not_core: This paper does not include experimental validation of the predicted bioink formulations or printed constructs, nor does it demonstrate autonomous decision-making in the bioprinting process.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少生物打印中生物墨水配方和打印参数的试错实验。
summary_zh.method: 用决策树预测生物墨水粘度，用k-means聚类分析支架力学和生物学特性。
summary_zh.result: 集成方法加速了生物打印过程，提高了支架的机械完整性和细胞活力。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅基于模型训练和聚类分析。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the trial-and-error experimentation in optimizing bioink formulations and printing parameters for extrusion-based bioprinting.
summary_en.method: A decision tree model predicts bioink viscosity from composition, and k-means clustering groups scaffolds by mechanical and biological properties to identify optimal characteristics.
summary_en.result: The integrated computational approach accelerates bioprinting and improves scaffold mechanical integrity and cell viability.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the study relies solely on model training and clustering analysis.

title: Gaussian process surrogate with physical law-corrected prior for multi-coupled PDEs defined on irregular geometry
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理定律修正高斯过程代理模型可高效处理多耦合偏微分方程，其方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on implant or biomechanics problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on general PDEs rather than design optimization with constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低参数化偏微分方程高保真数值模拟的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 结合POD降维与物理定律修正先验的高斯过程代理模型
summary_zh.result: 在非线性多耦合及不规则几何问题上精度与效率优于基线方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个二维不规则区域上的数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the prohibitive computational cost of repeated high-fidelity simulations for parametric PDEs.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process surrogate with a law-corrected prior, using POD for dimension reduction and RBF-FD for handling irregular domains.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on nonlinear multi-coupled PDEs and irregular geometries compared to baseline approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validated through extensive numerical experiments on multi-parameter systems and multi-coupled variables on irregular 2D domains.

summary_en.result: GRACE enables adaptive vascular-like geometries around cell-laden bioinks and precise alignment of sequential prints, improving functionality.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed through synthetic objects and biofabrication applications, including adaptive structures with cell-laden bioinks.

title: AI-guided biomaterials and biofabrication strategies for enhanced tumor extracellular matrix mimicry
relevance_to_user: 该论文将AI整合到生物打印工作流中，用于模拟肿瘤细胞外基质，与用户研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on tumor ECM mimicry rather than general bioprinting for tissue engineering or regenerative medicine.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用AI指导生物材料和生物打印策略以更好地模拟肿瘤细胞外基质。
summary_zh.method: 结合AI算法优化生物墨水和打印参数，构建肿瘤微环境模型。
summary_zh.result: 实现了更逼真的肿瘤ECM模拟，提高了药物筛选的准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验验证了模拟基质的生物学功能。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance tumor extracellular matrix mimicry by integrating AI into biomaterial selection and biofabrication processes.
summary_en.method: AI algorithms were employed to optimize bioink composition and printing parameters for constructing tumor microenvironment models.
summary_en.result: The approach achieved more realistic tumor ECM mimics, improving drug screening accuracy.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays validated the biological functionality of the mimicked matrix.

title: Morephy-Net: An Evolutionary Multi-objective Optimization for Replica-Exchange-based Physics-informed Neural Operator Learning Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多目标优化与不确定性量化方法可直接迁移至生物力学代理模型与植入物设计优化。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems; only tested on 1D PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决物理信息神经网络中损失加权与噪声鲁棒性问题。
summary_zh.method: 结合进化多目标优化与副本交换随机梯度Langevin动力学。
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers方程和分数阶扩散波方程上提高了精度和不确定性校准。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证，无实验或生物力学案例。

summary_en.motivation: To address the coupled challenges of loss balancing, noise robustness, and uncertainty quantification in physics-informed operator learning.
summary_en.method: Integrates evolutionary multi-objective optimization for Pareto front discovery with replica-exchange stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics for global exploration and Bayesian uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates consistent improvements in accuracy, noise robustness, and calibrated uncertainty estimates on 1D Burgers and time-fractional mixed diffusion-wave equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks (1D PDEs) without experimental or biomechanical case studies.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Diagram of Morephy-Net. The framework integrates three key components: (A) evolutionary multi-objective optimization (EMO), (B) replica exchange stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (RE-SGLD), and (C) Bayesian uncertainty quantification (UQ).

title: I-FENN with DeepONets: accelerating simulations in coupled multiphysics problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的I-FENN与DeepONet混合框架可显著加速多物理场耦合仿真，其方法可直接迁移至生物力学中的植入物多物理场优化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 多物理场耦合仿真计算成本高，需加速方法。
summary_zh.method: 将DeepONet作为PDE求解器嵌入FEM，解耦多物理场，构建混合交错求解器。
summary_zh.result: 在热弹性和孔隙弹性问题上，计算效率显著提升，精度超过95%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证，测试未见过的载荷条件。

summary_en.motivation: Coupled multiphysics simulations are computationally prohibitive, necessitating efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A hybrid staggered solver integrates DeepONet as a PDE solver within FEM, decoupling the mechanical field (FEM) from other coupled fields (NN).
summary_en.result: The framework achieves over 95% accuracy on unseen loading conditions while reducing computational cost, with savings scaling with model complexity.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples on thermoelasticity and poroelasticity problems demonstrate accuracy and generalization.

title: Self-Composing Neural Operators with Depth and Accuracy Scaling via Adaptive Train-and-Unroll Approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自组合神经算子与自适应训练方法可显著提升代理模型的计算效率与精度，适用于生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升神经算子在求解偏微分方程时的效率与精度
summary_zh.method: 通过自组合与自适应训练逐步加深模型深度
summary_zh.result: 在标准基准和超声CT问题上达到最优性能
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准和超声CT模拟案例上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of neural operators for solving PDEs by leveraging iterative deepening.
summary_en.method: A self-composing neural operator framework with an adaptive train-and-unroll approach that gradually increases model depth.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks and a challenging high-frequency ultrasound computed tomography problem.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and a simulation case of ultrasound computed tomography.

title: Data-Driven Bifurcation Handling in Physics-Based Reduced-Order Vascular Hemodynamic Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合降阶模型方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模，解决高保真仿真效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on vascular hemodynamics and does not address implant mechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 3D血流仿真计算成本高，降阶模型在分叉处精度不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出RRI模型，用神经网络预测分叉系数并集成到0D模型中。
summary_zh.result: 入口压力误差从45%降至17%，在高雷诺数和大血管网络中效果显著。
summary_zh.validation: 与3D有限元仿真对比，验证孤立分叉和血管树。

summary_en.motivation: High computational cost of 3D cardiovascular simulations motivates efficient reduced-order models with improved bifurcation accuracy.
summary_en.method: A resistor-resistor-inductor (RRI) model integrates neural network-predicted bifurcation coefficients into a 0D hemodynamic model via optimization.
summary_en.result: The RRI model reduces inlet pressure error from 45% to 17% compared to standard 0D models across Reynolds numbers up to 5500.
summary_en.validation: Validation against 3D finite element simulations on isolated bifurcations and vascular trees demonstrates accuracy improvements.

visual.caption: Figure 2: 3D bifurcation, labeled with relevant scaling factors and the non-dimensional parameters used to predict the RRI parameters (right). 0D RRI representation of bifurcation using circuit components with characteristic parameters predicted from the 3D geometry.

title: QUEENS: An Open-Source Python Framework for Solver-Independent Analyses of Large-Scale Computational Models
relevance_to_user: 该框架提供多保真度不确定性量化和贝叶斯反演算法，可直接迁移至植入物力学仿真中的代理建模与UQ任务。
why_not_core: This paper presents a general-purpose simulation analysis framework without specific application to implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模计算模型（如数字孪生）需要高效、可复用的仿真分析框架。
summary_zh.method: 开发开源Python框架QUEENS，集成多保真UQ、贝叶斯反演和概率机器学习算法。
summary_zh.result: 提供模块化、可扩展的仿真管理工具，支持任意求解器和分布式计算。
summary_zh.validation: 未提供具体验证案例，仅描述框架设计。

summary_en.motivation: Large-scale computational models, such as patient-specific digital twins, require efficient and reusable frameworks for systematic simulation analyses.
summary_en.method: QUEENS is an open-source Python framework that integrates multi-fidelity uncertainty quantification, Bayesian inverse analysis, and probabilistic machine learning with modular architecture for solver-independent simulations.
summary_en.result: The framework enables scalable and hierarchical analysis of complex models, facilitating uncertainty quantification and optimization without requiring deep probability theory knowledge.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided; the paper focuses on framework design and capabilities.

title: Deep Intrinsic Coregionalization Multi-Output Gaussian Process Surrogate with Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度多输出高斯过程代理模型可有效提升昂贵仿真的采样效率，并支持主动学习，对生物力学植入物设计中的多目标优化与不确定性量化具有直接迁移潜力。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant/biomechanics design, lacks constraint handling, and does not include UQ beyond standard GP uncertainty.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多输出计算机仿真中昂贵采样效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出深度内在协同区域化多输出高斯过程，引入分层协同结构建模非线性依赖
summary_zh.result: 在基准测试中表现优于现有模型，主动学习策略有效选择信息点
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试与现有模型对比验证性能

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency in expensive multi-output computer simulations by developing a flexible surrogate model.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Deep Intrinsic Coregionalization Multi-Output Gaussian Process (deepICMGP) that extends the ICM with hierarchical coregionalization layers to capture nonlinear output dependencies.
summary_en.result: The deepICMGP achieves competitive performance on benchmark problems, and active learning integration enhances sequential design efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmark comparisons against state-of-the-art multi-output GP models.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对LPBF制造的不锈钢多孔支架，通过晶格结构匹配骨力学性能，并进行了体内骨整合测试，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not report fatigue testing, surface roughness, or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 不锈钢植入体因高刚度导致愈合延迟，需调整力学性能匹配骨骼。
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF制造不同单元尺寸的BCC晶格结构，并填充硫酸钙骨水泥改性。
summary_zh.result: 支架屈服强度>60 MPa，弹性模量>1.7 GPa，体内骨整合显著改善。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟体液浸泡、细胞毒性实验和兔股骨植入验证。

summary_en.motivation: Stainless steel implants suffer from delayed healing due to high stiffness, necessitating mechanical property matching with bone.
summary_en.method: BCC lattice structures with varying unit sizes were fabricated by selective laser melting and modified with calcium sulphate bone cement.
summary_en.result: The implants achieved yield strength >60 MPa and Young's modulus >1.7 GPa, with enhanced osseointegration in vivo.
summary_en.validation: Validation included corrosion testing in simulated body fluid, cytotoxicity assays, and rabbit distal femur implantation.

title: 3D vector field-guided toolpathing for 3D bioprinting

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Biomedical Engineering, University of Minnesota, Minneapolis, MN, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文将AI算法（DTMRI数据处理与路径规划）直接集成到生物打印的预处理阶段，实现了从成像数据到打印路径的自动化，具有实验验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI for autonomous decision-making or closed-loop control during printing; it focuses on pre-processing toolpath generation without in-situ monitoring or feedback.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用DTMRI数据指导生物打印纤维取向，实现组织微结构复制。

title: Scalable h-adaptive probabilistic solver for time-independent and time-dependent systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的概率数值求解器，通过随机对偶下降和聚类主动学习实现h自适应，显著降低了计算复杂度，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it include any experimental or clinical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 概率数值求解PDE的计算成本高，需提高可扩展性
summary_zh.method: 提出随机对偶下降算法和聚类主动学习实现线性复杂度h自适应求解
summary_zh.result: 在2D/3D稳态椭圆问题和时空抛物问题上验证了可扩展性
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: Probabilistic PDE solvers suffer from cubic computational cost, limiting their scalability to large-scale problems.
summary_en.method: A stochastic dual descent algorithm reduces per-iteration complexity to linear, combined with clustering-based active learning for h-adaptive collocation point selection.
summary_en.result: The proposed solver achieves scalable inference on 2D/3D elliptic and space-time parabolic PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems.

title: Physics- and geometry-aware spatio-spectral graph neural operator for time-independent and time-dependent PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理与几何感知图神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决复杂几何下的高效仿真问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解复杂几何上的偏微分方程，减少对标注数据的依赖。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理与几何感知的时空谱图神经算子，结合高阶时间推进与随机投影损失。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上优于现有物理信息神经算子方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过规则与复杂几何上的稳态和瞬态PDE算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve PDEs on complex geometries with limited labeled data by learning solution operators.
summary_en.method: A physics- and geometry-aware spatio-spectral graph neural operator is proposed, incorporating a hybrid physics-informed loss with higher-order time marching and stochastic projection.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms state-of-the-art physics-informed neural operators on benchmark problems with regular and complex domains.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on time-independent and time-dependent PDEs with varying geometries.
