title: Prediction error certification for PINNs: Theory, computation, and application to Stokes flow
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的PINN误差认证框架，能够量化预测不确定性，对生物力学代理模型中的可靠性评估具有重要参考价值。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address multi-objective optimization or constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 为PINN提供严格的预测误差认证，突破学术示例限制。
summary_zh.method: 改进半群框架，提出数值策略近似稳定性参数。
summary_zh.result: 成功应用于圆柱绕流问题，实现更真实场景的误差认证。
summary_zh.validation: 通过Stokes流数值算例验证框架有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To extend rigorous error certification for PINNs from academic examples to more realistic problems.
summary_en.method: Modify the semigroup-based error bound and propose numerical strategies to approximate input-to-state stability parameters.
summary_en.result: The extended framework enables certification of PINN predictions for Stokes flow around a cylinder.
summary_en.validation: Validated through a numerical study of Stokes flow around a cylinder.

title: GFocal: A Global-Focal Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on Arbitrary Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的全局-局部注意力融合方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决多尺度物理场预测问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子忽略局部与全局特征的协同学习，难以处理多尺度问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出GFocal，通过Nyström注意力全局块和切片聚焦局部块融合多尺度信息。
summary_zh.result: 在五个基准上平均相对提升15.2%，并成功应用于汽车和翼型气动模拟。
summary_zh.validation: 在六个标准PDE基准和工业级气动模拟上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators overlook coordinated learning of local and global features, limiting multiscale PDE solving.
summary_en.method: GFocal uses Nyström attention for global blocks and slice-based focal blocks for local features, fused via convolutional gating.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art with 15.2% average relative gain on five benchmarks and excels in industrial aerodynamics simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on six standard PDE benchmarks and large-scale automotive/airfoil simulations.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可微坐标变换的PINN框架，可高效处理不规则几何域，对生物力学植入物FEA代理建模具有直接迁移价值。

summary_en.motivation: To address instability and slow convergence of PINNs on irregular domains due to geometric anisotropy and loss imbalance.

summary_en.result: Reduces L2 error from 0.11-0.73 to 0.01-0.09, achieves millisecond-level mapping for unseen geometries, and improves accuracy by 3.65x with over 10x speedup.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on various PDEs and vessel-like domains with varying shapes.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的点态扩散模型可高效预测复杂物理系统，其处理网格和点云的能力可直接迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently predict complex physical systems with shape variations, overcoming the limitations of image-based diffusion models on unstructured data like meshes and point clouds.
summary_en.method: A point-wise diffusion model is proposed, applying forward and backward diffusion processes at individual spatio-temporal points with a point-wise diffusion transformer for denoising.
summary_en.result: The model reduces training time by 94.4%, parameters by 89.0%, improves prediction accuracy by over 28%, and achieves 100-200x inference speedup compared to image-based diffusion models.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 2D cylinder flow, OLED drop impact, and 3D car external aerodynamics, with comparisons against DeepONet and Meshgraphnet.

summary_zh.motivation: 骨水泥与3D打印植入物界面的粘附性能缺乏基础数据。
summary_zh.method: 通过剪切测试评估不同表面形貌（多孔、喷砂、机加工、抛光）的骨水泥粘附强度。
summary_zh.result: 多孔表面粘附强度（26.3 MPa）是非多孔表面的两倍以上，且性能与孔隙尺寸和层深相关。
summary_zh.validation: 实验剪切测试验证了粘附强度，并比较了不同表面处理。

summary_en.motivation: There is a lack of foundational data on how bone cement adheres to 3D printed implant surfaces with varying topographies.
summary_en.method: Adhesion strength of bone cement to clinically relevant printed implant surfaces, including porous layers and traditional finishes, was evaluated in shear tests.
summary_en.result: Porous surfaces exhibited more than double the adhesive strength (26.3 ± 3.1 MPa) compared to non-porous surfaces, with performance depending on porosity size and layer depth.
summary_en.validation: Experimental shear testing validated adhesion strength across different surface types and porous geometries.

title: LVM-GP: Uncertainty-Aware PDE Solver via coupling latent variable model and Gaussian process
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合潜变量模型和高斯过程的不确定性感知PDE求解器，其方法可直接迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中，解决昂贵仿真采样效率问题并提供不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, and lacks validation on real-world biomechanical FEA scenarios.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PDE求解器缺乏可靠的不确定性量化，且计算效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出LVM-GP框架，结合潜变量高斯过程与神经算子，构建随机映射实现不确定性感知求解。
summary_zh.result: 在数值实验中，该方法在预测精度和不确定性量化上优于B-PINNs和深度集成方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个标准PDE数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PDE solvers lack reliable uncertainty quantification and suffer from low computational efficiency.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic framework LVM-GP is proposed, coupling a latent variable model based on Gaussian process with a neural operator to construct a stochastic mapping for uncertainty-aware PDE solving.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive predictive accuracy and robust uncertainty quantification, outperforming B-PINNs and deep ensembles on numerical benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple standard PDE numerical benchmarks.

key_terms.zh: 贝叶斯物理信息神经网络

title: Locally Adaptive Conformal Inference for Operator Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的局部自适应共形推断方法可直接用于替代模型的预测不确定性量化，提升生物力学设计中的可靠性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics; it focuses on spatiotemporal forecasting and physics emulation without constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 为算子模型提供具有局部适应性的预测集，解决现有共形方法在函数值预测中适应性不足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部切片共形推断（LSCI），一种无需分布假设的框架，生成函数值预测集并证明有限样本有效性。
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据和实际应用中，LSCI比基线方法产生更紧且适应性更强的预测集，对偏差预测和分布外噪声具有鲁棒性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过高斯过程合成任务及空气质量、能源、天气三个真实数据集验证。

summary_en.motivation: To provide locally adaptive prediction sets for operator models, addressing the lack of adaptivity in existing conformal methods for function-valued outputs.
summary_en.method: Proposes Local Sliced Conformal Inference (LSCI), a distribution-free framework that generates function-valued prediction sets with finite-sample validity and a data-dependent coverage gap bound under local exchangeability.
summary_en.result: LSCI yields tighter and more adaptive prediction sets than conformal baselines on synthetic and real tasks, demonstrating robustness against biased predictions and certain out-of-distribution noise.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic Gaussian process tasks and three real-world applications: air quality monitoring, energy demand forecasting, and weather prediction.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Residual functions from a neural operator model applied to energy demand (Section 4.2 ). ( Left ) Residuals vary smoothly across inputs, showing nonstationary amplitude and shape. ( Middle / Right ) Local residual covariance structures at two distant inputs. Their anisotropy and orientation differ substantially, illustrating the failure of global exchangeability and the need for geometrically adaptive local conformal methods.

title: Deep Polynomial Chaos Expansion
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展至高维输入空间的深度多项式混沌展开方法，能够高效计算统计矩和灵敏度指标，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的不确定性量化与代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any biomedical or implant-related problem, nor does it include any FEA validation or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统多项式混沌展开在高维输入下基函数数量指数增长，可扩展性差。
summary_zh.method: 将多项式混沌展开与概率电路结合，提出深度多项式混沌展开（DeepPCE）。
summary_zh.result: DeepPCE在预测性能上媲美多层感知机，同时保留精确统计推断能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个高维数值基准问题上验证了精度和可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: Polynomial chaos expansion suffers from exponential growth of basis functions in high-dimensional input spaces, limiting its scalability.
summary_en.method: Deep polynomial chaos expansion (DeepPCE) integrates PCE with tractable probabilistic circuits to achieve a deep generalization that scales to high dimensions.
summary_en.result: DeepPCE achieves predictive performance comparable to multilayer perceptrons while retaining exact computation of statistical moments and sensitivity indices.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on several high-dimensional numerical benchmark problems, demonstrating accuracy and scalability.

visual.caption: Figure 5: Random test samples for the Darcy flow dataset (left) and the steady-state diffusion dataset (right) from DeepPCE, MLP and UNet. The first column of panels show random input samples, the second column the corresponding true targets. The results show that the DeepPCE manages to closely approximate the PDE results, offering predictive performance that is competitive against the UNet and the MLP, while also offering tractable and exact inference.

title: Multi-fidelity Bayesian Data-Driven Design of Energy Absorbing Spinodoid Cellular Structures
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真贝叶斯优化方法可直接迁移到植入物设计中的昂贵有限元仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵有限元仿真下数据驱动设计效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 采用多保真贝叶斯优化结合Sobol敏感性分析
summary_zh.result: 多保真BO比单保真BO在能量吸收优化中性能提升11%
summary_zh.validation: 通过自旋体蜂窝结构有限元仿真案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reconcile the increasing computational cost of FE simulations with the growing demand for data-driven design.
summary_en.method: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) combined with Sobol' variance-based sensitivity analysis to reduce design complexity.
summary_en.result: MFBO outperforms single-fidelity BO by up to 11% in maximizing energy absorption of spinodoid cellular structures.
summary_en.validation: Validated through FE simulations of spinodoid structures with varying mesh fidelities.

title: Effect of node-strengthened shape on mechanical properties of body-centered-cubic lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: School of Computer and Artificial Intelligence, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing 100048, China

corresponding_authors.name: Wentian Shi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Computer and Artificial Intelligence, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing 100048, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了SLM制造BCC点阵结构的力学性能与节点强化形状的关系，与用户关注的LPBF制造多孔植入物力学性能匹配高度相关。
why_not_core: Does not report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration; no fatigue testing or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究节点强化形状对SLM制造BCC点阵结构力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 设计不同节点形状的BCC点阵，通过SLM制备并进行准静态压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 节点强化形状显著影响点阵的弹性模量和屈服强度，可调节力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验压缩测试验证力学性能变化趋势。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how node-strengthened shapes affect the mechanical properties of BCC lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: BCC lattice structures with various node geometries were designed, fabricated via SLM, and tested under quasi-static compression.
summary_en.result: Node shape significantly influences elastic modulus and yield strength, enabling tunable mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests validated the mechanical property variations.

title: HeartUnloadNet: A Weakly-Supervised Cycle-Consistent Graph Network for Predicting Unloaded Cardiac Geometry from Diastolic States
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于预测心脏卸载几何的深度学习方法，其循环一致性图网络和弱监督策略可迁移至生物力学中其他逆有限元问题，如植入物应力屏蔽预测。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on cardiac biomechanics and does not address implant stress shielding, contact mechanics, or bone-implant interface, which are central to the user's hip implant direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统逆有限元求解器计算昂贵，难以实时临床应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出HeartUnloadNet，基于图注意力网络和循环一致性策略，从舒张期网格预测卸载几何。
summary_zh.result: 亚毫米精度，DSC 0.986，推理时间0.02秒，比传统方法快10^5倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在20700个有限元模拟案例上训练和测试。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional inverse finite element solvers for estimating unloaded cardiac geometry are computationally expensive, hindering real-time clinical applications.
summary_en.method: HeartUnloadNet employs a graph attention network with cycle-consistency to predict unloaded left ventricular mesh from end-diastolic mesh and physiological parameters.
summary_en.result: The model achieves sub-millimeter accuracy (DSC 0.986, HD 0.083 cm) and reduces inference time to 0.02 seconds, over 10^5 times faster than conventional solvers.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on 20,700 finite element simulations covering diverse geometries and physiological conditions.

title: PICore: Physics-Informed Unsupervised Coreset Selection for Data Efficient Neural Operator Training
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无监督核心集选择方法，可显著减少训练神经算子所需的昂贵模拟数据量，直接解决了FEA替代建模中的采样效率问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, and does not address constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子训练需要大量昂贵模拟数据，降低标注成本是关键。
summary_zh.method: 提出无监督核心集选择框架PICore，利用物理信息损失筛选最有信息量的输入样本。
summary_zh.result: 在四个PDE基准上，训练效率平均提升78%，精度几乎不变。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上对比多种核心集选择策略。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators require large labeled datasets from expensive numerical simulations, motivating a method to reduce annotation costs.
summary_en.method: PICore uses a physics-informed loss to select the most informative unlabeled inputs for coreset selection, then labels only those via simulation.
summary_en.result: Across four PDE benchmarks, PICore achieves up to 78% average increase in training efficiency with minimal accuracy loss.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE numerical benchmarks against multiple supervised coreset selection baselines.

title: A Learning-based Domain Decomposition Method
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于学习的域分解方法，可高效求解复杂几何上的偏微分方程，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle multi-objective constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有数值方法计算成本高，神经网络方法难以处理复杂几何。
summary_zh.method: 提出学习型域分解法，用预训练神经算子作为代理模型，分解复杂域求解。
summary_zh.result: 在含不连续微结构的椭圆PDE上优于现有方法，具有分辨率不变性和泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证，与现有方法对比精度和效率。

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently solving PDEs on large and complex geometries remains challenging for traditional numerical methods and existing neural approaches.
summary_en.method: A learning-based domain decomposition method (L-DDM) is proposed, using a single pre-trained neural operator as a surrogate within a domain decomposition scheme.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms state-of-the-art on elliptic PDEs with discontinuous microstructures, offering resolution-invariance and strong generalization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on complex geometries with comparison to existing methods.

summary_en.method: Integration of autopilot single-jet electrospun 3D PCL fiber scaffolds with hydrogel dip-coating and contour bioprinting for anatomical precision and mechanical robustness.

summary_en.validation: In vivo animal studies confirmed tissue bridging, cell infiltration, and ECM collagen deposition.

title: Bayesian BiLO: Bilevel Local Operator Learning for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification of Bayesian PDE Inverse Problems with Low-Rank Adaptation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯双层局部算子学习框架（B-BiLO）通过低秩自适应实现高效不确定性量化，其方法可直接迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理建模与不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization in engineering design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效量化PDE反问题中的不确定性，避免传统方法的高计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出双层局部算子学习框架，上层HMC采样，下层LoRA微调神经网络近似解算子。
summary_zh.result: 在肿瘤生长等PDE模型上实现了准确且高效的不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证，包括肿瘤生长PDE模型。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient uncertainty quantification in PDE inverse problems without the high computational cost of traditional methods.
summary_en.method: Proposes a bilevel local operator learning framework (B-BiLO) that uses Hamiltonian Monte Carlo at the upper level and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to fine-tune a neural operator at the lower level.
summary_en.result: Achieves accurate and efficient uncertainty quantification across PDE models, including tumor growth.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on PDE models, including a tumor growth model.

title: Missing Physics Discovery through Fully Differentiable Finite Element-Based Machine Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的FEML框架通过可微有限元求解器嵌入训练，能够从数据中学习未知物理算子（如本构模型），并支持零样本泛化，可迁移至植入物力学建模中的材料参数识别或代理模型构建。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on discovering missing physics (e.g., constitutive laws) rather than directly addressing expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有代理模型仅学习PDE解，无法直接发现未知物理规律。
summary_zh.method: 提出FEML框架，将可微有限元求解器与算子网络结合，端到端学习缺失物理算子。
summary_zh.result: 成功恢复非线性应力-应变律并零样本泛化至新场景，识别瞬态热传导中的温度相关电导率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成实验数据验证，展示零样本迁移和跨离散化泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: Existing surrogate models learn PDE solutions directly from data but fail to discover the underlying missing physics (e.g., constitutive laws) that govern the system.
summary_en.method: FEML integrates a differentiable finite element solver with structure-preserving operator networks to learn unknown physical operators end-to-end from solution data.
summary_en.result: The framework recovers nonlinear stress-strain laws from synthetic tests and identifies temperature-dependent conductivity in transient heat flow, achieving zero-shot generalization to new scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic laboratory test data, demonstrating zero-shot transfer and generalization across different mesh resolutions and discretizations.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Machine Learning-Based Prediction: A Polynomial Chaos Expansion Approach for Joint Model and Input Uncertainty Propagation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于多项式混沌展开的不确定性量化框架可直接迁移至生物力学代理模型，解决输入不确定性与模型误差的联合传播问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to any specific biomedical or implant design problem, nor does it demonstrate validation on FEA-based surrogate models.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器学习代理模型预测误差与输入不确定性耦合，需可靠量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 基于多项式混沌展开，将输入与模型不确定性统一映射到标准空间构建代理。
summary_zh.result: 高效计算输出均值和标准差，并实现全局灵敏度分析。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证方法准确性与效率。

summary_en.motivation: To enable trustworthy engineering predictions, a framework is needed to jointly propagate input variability and ML model uncertainty.
summary_en.method: A Polynomial Chaos Expansion (PCE) surrogate is constructed in a unified standard space to propagate both input and model uncertainties from Gaussian Process regression.
summary_en.result: The proposed method efficiently computes output mean and standard deviation and provides global sensitivity analysis to quantify individual uncertainty contributions.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on numerical benchmark problems, demonstrating accuracy and computational efficiency.

title: Single- to multi-fidelity history-dependent learning with uncertainty quantification and disentanglement: application to data-driven constitutive modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真度历史依赖学习方法可迁移至植入物力学代理建模，解决昂贵仿真采样效率问题，并具备不确定性量化能力。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, and lacks validation on FEA surrogate tasks with constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决历史依赖多保真度数据学习中的不确定性量化与解耦问题
summary_zh.method: 提出层次化多保真度方差估计贝叶斯循环神经网络
summary_zh.result: 准确预测响应并量化模型误差，发现噪声分布
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个保真度水平的本构建模数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To generalize data-driven learning to history-dependent multi-fidelity data while quantifying epistemic uncertainty and disentangling it from aleatoric noise.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical framework extending from single-fidelity deterministic networks to multi-fidelity variance-estimating Bayesian recurrent neural networks.
summary_en.result: The method accurately predicts material response, quantifies model error, and discovers noise distribution when present.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple data-driven constitutive modeling scenarios with varying fidelities and noise levels.

title: Optimization of SA-Gel Hydrogel Printing Parameters for Extrusion-Based 3D Bioprinting
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical and Material Engineering, Xi’an University, Xi’an 710065, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文将机器学习模型用于挤出式生物打印参数优化，直接提升了打印精度，与AI辅助生物打印方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not address autonomous decision-making or closed-loop control; it focuses on offline parameter optimization without real-time feedback.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少挤出式生物打印中参数试错成本，提高打印精度。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce trial-and-error in extrusion-based bioprinting by data-driven optimization of printing parameters.

title: Universal Fourier Neural Operators for periodic homogenization problems in linear elasticity
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的通用傅里叶神经算子可直接用于解决生物力学中周期性均质化问题，为植入物多尺度模拟提供高效替代模型。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific constraints, uncertainty quantification, or multi-objective optimization in biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决周期性均质化中细胞问题求解困难且现有深度学习方法效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 基于FFT基本方案构建无需训练的通用傅里叶神经算子代理模型
summary_zh.result: 算子可预测任意刚度分布下的细胞问题解，精度均匀且可处理超1亿体素的大规模问题
summary_zh.validation: 理论证明通用逼近性质，无需数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the difficulty of solving cell problems in periodic homogenization and the inefficiency of existing deep learning frameworks.
summary_en.method: Construct a universal Fourier Neural Operator surrogate that mimics the basic scheme of FFT-based micromechanics methods without requiring training.
summary_en.result: The operator predicts solutions to cell problems with arbitrary stiffness distributions under a material-contrast constraint, achieving uniform accuracy and handling over 100 million voxels.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proof of universal approximation property; no numerical or experimental validation.

title: Distribution-Free Uncertainty-Aware Virtual Sensing via Conformalized Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的无分布不确定性量化方法可直接迁移到生物力学代理模型，解决植入物设计中的可靠预测问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate modeling, and lacks validation on biomedical design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 为神经算子提供高效可靠的不确定性量化，解决虚拟传感中的安全部署问题。
summary_zh.method: 将蒙特卡洛dropout与分裂共形预测统一到DeepONet架构中，实现无分布预测区间。
summary_zh.result: 在湍流、弹塑性变形和宇宙辐射三个案例中均达到近名义覆盖率的校准不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个不同物理领域的仿真案例验证方法的覆盖率和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To provide efficient and reliable uncertainty quantification for neural operators, enabling safe deployment in real-time virtual sensing applications.
summary_en.method: Unifies Monte Carlo dropout with split conformal prediction in a single DeepONet architecture to produce distribution-free prediction intervals without retraining or ensembling.
summary_en.result: Achieves near-nominal empirical coverage across turbulent flow, elastoplastic deformation, and cosmic radiation dose estimation, even under strong spatial gradients.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three distinct simulation cases from fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and radiation physics, demonstrating generalizability and calibration.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the prohibitive computational cost of FEM simulations for thermal history prediction in large-scale wire-arc directed energy deposition.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network surrogate is developed with efficient collocation point sampling to enable scalable and rapid thermal simulation.
summary_en.result: The PINN surrogate achieves up to 98.6% reduction in computational time while maintaining accuracy and providing super-resolution capability.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing PINN predictions against FEM simulation results for a wire-arc DED process.

title: Stochastic Operator Network: A Stochastic Maximum Principle Based Approach to Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的随机算子网络（SON）能够学习算子中的不确定性，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子学习方法缺乏不确定性量化能力。
summary_zh.method: 将分支网络建模为随机微分方程，结合随机最大值原理与DeepONet。
summary_zh.result: 在2D和3D含噪算子学习任务中有效量化不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证不确定性量化效果。

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods lack inherent uncertainty quantification, limiting their reliability in safety-critical applications.
summary_en.method: SON formulates the branch net as an SDE and leverages the adjoint BSDE and stochastic maximum principle to learn both the operator and its uncertainty through diffusion parameters.
summary_en.result: SON effectively replicates noisy operators in 2D and 3D, providing uncertainty estimates alongside predictions.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic noisy operator learning benchmarks in 2D and 3D.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Hard Nonlinear Equality and Inequality Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的KKT-Hardnet方法能够严格满足非线性约束，可迁移至植入物设计中的多约束优化问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN无法严格满足工程约束，影响模型可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 提出KKT-Hardnet，通过可微投影求解KKT条件实现严格约束满足。
summary_zh.result: 在非凸混合问题和化工过程仿真中实现严格约束满足，避免数据与物理残差平衡。
summary_zh.validation: 通过非凸混合问题和化工过程仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional PINNs cannot guarantee strict satisfaction of engineering constraints, compromising model reliability.
summary_en.method: KKT-Hardnet enforces linear and nonlinear equality and inequality constraints up to machine precision via differentiable projection solving KKT conditions.
summary_en.result: The method achieves strict constraint satisfaction on nonconvex pooling and chemical process simulations, eliminating the need to balance data and physics residuals.
summary_en.validation: Validated on nonconvex pooling problem and a real-world chemical process simulation.

summary_en.motivation: To compare clinically relevant differences in stress shielding between two short-stem femoral prostheses using DEXA-based bone mineral density measurements.
summary_en.method: A prospective randomized study of 52 patients receiving either Nanos or Optimys short-stem prostheses, with Gruen-zone DEXA and radiographic follow-up at 12 months.
summary_en.result: The Optimys stem showed significantly better preservation of proximal femoral BMD, particularly in Gruen zones 1, 4, and 7, indicating reduced stress shielding.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation via DEXA scans and radiographic measurements in a randomized patient cohort.

title: Bridging Sequential Deep Operator Network and Video Diffusion: Residual Refinement of Spatio-Temporal PDE Solutions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合深度算子网络和视频扩散的混合代理模型，用于高效求解时空PDE，其残差学习策略和跨领域迁移能力对生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模具有直接借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the surrogate to implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统PDE求解器计算成本高的问题，提升代理模型对高频细节的预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 两阶段框架：S-DeepONet生成粗预测，条件视频扩散模型学习残差以细化结果。
summary_zh.result: 混合模型在流场和塑性问题上分别将相对L2误差降低81.8%和33.5%。
summary_zh.validation: 在顶盖驱动空腔流和狗骨拉伸塑性两个基准算例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of traditional PDE solvers while improving surrogate model accuracy for high-frequency spatio-temporal features.
summary_en.method: A two-stage framework where a Sequential Deep Operator Network (S-DeepONet) provides a coarse physics-consistent prior, and a conditional video diffusion model refines the residual between the prior and ground truth.
summary_en.result: The hybrid surrogate reduces mean relative L2 error from 4.57% to 0.83% for cavity flow and from 4.42% to 2.94% for plasticity, achieving relative improvements of 81.8% and 33.5%.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two benchmarks: lid-driven cavity flow and tensile plastic deformation of dogbone specimens.

summary_en.result: Single-branch networks significantly outperform multi-branch counterparts in strongly coupled settings, achieving up to 1.8e4 times speedup over high-fidelity solvers.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three numerical benchmarks: reaction-diffusion, nonlinear thermo-electrical, and viscoplastic thermo-mechanical problems.

summary_en.result: The framework demonstrates robust and accurate solution prediction on transient Poisson, elastodynamic, and thermoelastic problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on three numerical benchmarks of transient mechanics problems.

summary_en.method: A 3D printing-neural network co-modelling framework was developed, using multi-material 3D-printed biomimetic bone models and DIC experimental data to train forward and inverse neural networks.

summary_zh.method: 整合三维术前规划与有限元建模，基于虚拟手术数据生成个体化模型。
summary_zh.result: 自动化显著缩短仿真设置时间，提高高性能计算效率。
summary_zh.validation: 使用HFValid开源数据集和商业植入物进行案例演示。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an automated computational framework for predicting primary implant stability in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: The framework integrates three-dimensional preoperative planning with finite element modeling, generating subject-specific models from virtual surgery data.
summary_en.result: Automation substantially reduced simulation setup time and improved efficiency on high-performance computing infrastructure.
summary_en.validation: The pipeline was demonstrated using data from the open-source HFValid collection and a commercial implant.

why_not_core: This paper does not advance to autonomous decision-making or closed-loop control; it uses ML only for post-printing image analysis, not for real-time process optimization.

summary_en.motivation: To optimize extrusion-based 3D bioprinting parameters for a gelatin/siloxane hybrid material to achieve high fidelity to the CAD design.
summary_en.method: A multi-faceted approach integrating rheological characterization, computational fluid dynamics simulations, and a convolutional neural network for post-printing image analysis was employed to refine printing parameters.
summary_en.result: The optimized parameters improved print fidelity from 54.5% to 94.13% CAD similarity.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing the printed constructs to the original CAD design using similarity metrics.

title: Data-Driven Topology Optimization for Multiscale Biomimetic Spinodal Design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种数据驱动的多尺度拓扑优化框架，使用高斯过程代理模型替代计算均匀化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific constraints, and lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决旋节线材料设计中维度灾难和梯度计算困难的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出数据驱动多尺度拓扑优化框架，用神经网络参数化设计变量，高斯过程代理本构模型
summary_zh.result: 框架能自动计算拓扑梯度，避免重复均匀化，提供材料分布的物理解释
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证优化效果和可解释性

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the curse of dimensionality and gradient derivation challenges in spinodoid architected material design.
summary_en.method: A data-driven multiscale topology optimization framework is proposed, where design variables are parameterized by neural networks and a Gaussian Process surrogate replaces repeated computational homogenization.
summary_en.result: The framework enables automatic topological gradient computation, eliminates repeated homogenization, and provides physical interpretability of material distribution.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark examples demonstrate the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed optimization framework.

title: Data-Driven Optimization of Bioink Formulations for Extrusion-Based Bioprinting: A Predictive Modeling Approach

summary_zh.method: 使用机器学习模型预测生物墨水粘度并优化配方。
summary_zh.result: 优化配方打印出结构更稳定的构建物。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实际打印随机和优化配方进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance bioink printability for structurally stable bioprinted constructs in tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Machine learning models were trained to predict viscosity and optimize alginate-gelatin (ALGEC) formulations.
summary_en.result: Optimized formulations yielded bioprinted constructs with improved structural stability compared to random compositions.
summary_en.validation: Experimental bioprinting of random and optimized formulations validated the predictive model's effectiveness.

title: Leveraging transfer learning for efficient bioprinting.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Politecnico di Milano, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Via La Masa 1, 20156 Milan, Italy.

relevance_to_user: 该论文将迁移学习应用于生物打印过程建模，直接契合AI驱动生物打印的研究方向。
why_not_core: This paper does not include autonomous decision-making or closed-loop control; it focuses on model transfer rather than real-time optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 生物打印实验数据获取成本高，需提升建模效率。
summary_zh.method: 利用迁移学习将源材料知识迁移至目标材料，减少实验数据需求。
summary_zh.result: 迁移模型在有限数据下优于从头训练的模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过挤出生物打印案例，对比迁移与无迁移场景的预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce experimental burden in bioprinting process modeling by reusing knowledge across different materials and conditions.
summary_en.method: Transfer learning is applied to an extrusion-based bioprinting case, where a model trained on one material is adapted to a new material with limited data.
summary_en.result: The transferred model achieves higher accuracy than a model trained from scratch, especially under data-scarce scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via a simulation case study comparing transfer learning against a no-transfer baseline, with sensitivity analysis on training set size.

title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning Regulated by Finite Element Analysis for Simulation Acceleration of Laser Powder Bed Fusion
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的FEA-PINN框架可加速热场预测，其方法（动态材料更新、校正FEA）可迁移至生物力学/植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on LPBF thermal simulation, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or surrogate modeling for structural FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速激光粉末床熔融过程的热场模拟，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出FEA-PINN框架，结合动态材料更新和校正FEA仿真。
summary_zh.result: FEA-PINN在保持FEA精度的同时显著降低计算成本。
summary_zh.validation: 使用基准FEA数据验证，并通过单道扫描案例展示。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate thermal field simulation in laser powder bed fusion while maintaining accuracy, addressing the high computational cost of traditional FEA.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) regulated by corrective FEA simulations, incorporating dynamic material property updates and apparent heat capacity method.
summary_en.result: The FEA-PINN framework achieves equivalent accuracy to FEA with significantly reduced computational cost, and enables generalization via transfer learning.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark FEA data and demonstrated through single-track scanning in LPBF.

title: IMC-PINN-FE: A Physics-Informed Neural Network for Patient-Specific Left Ventricular Finite Element Modeling with Image Motion Consistency and Biomechanical Parameter Estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN与有限元结合，实现患者特异性心脏力学建模，其方法可迁移至植入物生物力学代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on cardiac biomechanics, not on implant stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统心脏有限元模拟计算昂贵且难以匹配临床影像运动。
summary_zh.method: 提出IMC-PINN-FE框架，整合影像运动一致性与PINN，快速估计心肌参数并加速FE模拟。
summary_zh.result: 相比传统逆有限元，速度提升75倍，Dice系数从0.849提升至0.927。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床MRI/超声影像数据，通过运动约束和压力-容积行为验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional finite element simulations of cardiac mechanics are computationally expensive and fail to reproduce clinically observed motions.
summary_en.method: IMC-PINN-FE integrates image motion consistency with a physics-informed neural network to rapidly estimate myocardial stiffness and active tension, then performs FE modeling at 75x speedup.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves a Dice improvement from 0.849 to 0.927 while preserving realistic pressure-volume behavior.
summary_en.validation: Validation uses clinical MRI/echocardiography data, comparing imaged displacements and pressure-volume loops.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统生物墨水配方依赖大量实验，效率低且难以预测非牛顿流体粘度。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯优化结合掩码技术，构建数据高效的粘度预测代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型预测误差低于10%，显著减少实验工作量，加速墨水配方筛选。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量不同配方的粘度进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional bioink optimization relies on extensive experimental testing, which is inefficient and struggles to predict the viscosity of non-Newtonian fluids.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework with a masking technique is introduced to build a data-efficient surrogate model for predicting bioink viscosity.
summary_en.result: The model achieves prediction errors of 10% or less, significantly reducing experimental workload and accelerating bioink formulation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through experimental viscosity measurements of various bioink compositions.

title: A Classification-Based Machine Learning Approach to Understand and Infer the Ultimate Successful Bioprinting Process
first_author_affiliation: Slippery Rock University , , ,

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Slippery Rock University , , ,

summary_zh.validation: 使用实验数据集进行训练和测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing studies optimize individual bioprinting tasks separately, lacking an integrated prediction of overall process success.
summary_en.method: A classification-based machine learning model was developed using 72 experimental datasets covering process parameters, rheology, filament fidelity, and cell viability.
summary_en.result: The model achieved 83% accuracy, demonstrating potential to reduce trial-and-error in bioprinting.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated on experimental data with 72 samples, including in vitro cell viability measurements.

title: A Neural Operator based Hybrid Microscale Model for Multiscale Simulation of Rate-Dependent Materials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合神经算子微观模型可加速多尺度模拟，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on viscoelastic materials and does not address implant-specific constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 多尺度模拟中微观尺度计算成本高，需加速方法。
summary_zh.method: 将神经算子与物理模型结合，构建混合微观模型预测微观物理。

summary_zh.validation: 通过粘弹性材料数值算例验证精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: Multiscale simulations are computationally expensive due to repeated microscale evaluations, motivating the need for efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A hybrid model integrating neural operators with physics-based principles is developed to predict microscale physics and internal variables.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves homogenized stress errors below 6% and approximately 100x speedup compared to full FE² simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on time-dependent viscoelastic solid mechanics problems using numerical simulation cases.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Mechanical Engineering, Anhui Science and Technology University

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了SLM制造的Ti-6Al-4V TPMS多孔结构的单元尺寸对力学性能的影响，与用户关注的增材制造生物医用植入物的力学匹配和疲劳性能高度相关。
why_not_core: The paper does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or osseointegration, and fatigue testing is not reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究单元尺寸对SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V TPMS多孔结构微观组织和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同单元尺寸的TPMS结构，进行微观表征和准静态压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 单元尺寸显著影响孔隙率、支柱尺寸和力学性能，小单元尺寸结构强度更高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM和EDS分析微观组织，压缩实验验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of unit cell size on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V TPMS structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: TPMS structures with varying unit cell sizes were manufactured via SLM and characterized using SEM, EDS, and quasi-static compression tests.
summary_en.result: Unit cell size significantly influences porosity, strut dimensions, and mechanical properties, with smaller unit cells yielding higher strength.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis and compression testing were performed to validate the mechanical performance.

title: From Local Interactions to Global Operators: Scalable Gaussian Process Operator for Physical Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的可扩展高斯过程算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决高维参数空间下的不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant FEA or biomechanics design, nor does it include any experimental validation in that domain.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有高斯过程算子计算复杂度高，难以扩展到高维大数据场景。
summary_zh.method: 利用局部核近似、稀疏核和Kronecker分解实现可扩展的高斯过程算子。
summary_zh.result: 在多种非线性PDE上验证了高精度和跨离散尺度的泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在Navier-Stokes、Darcy流等标准PDE基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Scaling probabilistic neural operators to high-dimensional, data-intensive regimes is hindered by cubic computational complexity.
summary_en.method: A scalable Gaussian Process Operator is proposed using nearest-neighbor local kernel approximations, sparse kernel approximation in parameter space, and structured Kronecker factorizations.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves high accuracy across varying discretization scales on a broad class of nonlinear PDEs including Navier-Stokes and Darcy flow.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems demonstrate accuracy and scalability.

title: Robust Physics-Informed Neural Network Approach for Estimating Heterogeneous Elastic Properties from Noisy Displacement Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的鲁棒PINN方法用于从噪声位移数据估计异质弹性参数，可迁移至生物力学中植入物-骨界面的材料属性反演。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 从噪声位移数据中准确估计异质弹性参数是逆弹性问题的挑战。
summary_zh.method: 提出IE-PINN，集成三个神经网络分别建模位移、应变和弹性分布，并采用两阶段估计策略。
summary_zh.result: 即使在严重噪声下也能准确恢复绝对尺度的弹性参数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证，与现有方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Accurately estimating heterogeneous elastic properties from noisy displacement data remains a significant challenge in inverse elasticity problems.
summary_en.method: IE-PINN integrates three neural networks for displacement, strain, and elasticity fields, with a two-phase strategy to recover relative distributions and absolute scale.
summary_en.result: The method delivers accurate absolute-scale elasticity estimations even under severe noise conditions.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate robustness against noise and superiority over existing methods.

title: GITO: Graph-Informed Transformer Operator for Learning Complex Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的图信息变换算子（GITO）能够高效学习不规则几何上的偏微分方程，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant FEA or biomechanics, and lacks uncertainty quantification and constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子在不规则网格上泛化能力不足，需开发高效网格无关的PDE代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出混合图变换器（HGT）与变换器神经算子（TNO）结合的GITO架构，实现局部与全局特征融合。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准PDE任务上超越现有变换器神经算子，支持零样本超分辨率。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证精度与泛化性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle with irregular geometries and non-uniform meshes, motivating a mesh-agnostic surrogate solver.
summary_en.method: GITO combines a hybrid graph transformer for local and global feature encoding with a transformer neural operator for discretization-invariant function mapping.
summary_en.result: GITO outperforms state-of-the-art transformer-based neural operators on benchmark PDE tasks and enables zero-shot super-resolution.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard numerical PDE benchmarks with accuracy and generalization metrics.

title: Accelerating PDE-Constrained Optimization by the Derivative of Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子导数增强和混合优化框架可直接迁移到生物力学植入物设计中的PDE约束优化问题。
why_not_core: No application to implant or biomechanics design; no uncertainty quantification; validation only on numerical benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速PDE约束优化中神经算子替代模型的训练与优化稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 提出优化导向训练、虚拟傅里叶层增强导数学习及混合优化框架。
summary_zh.result: 混合优化方法在多个基准问题上实现鲁棒收敛。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE优化基准上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate PDE-constrained optimization by addressing data inefficiency and instability of neural operator surrogates.
summary_en.method: Proposes optimization-oriented training, a Virtual-Fourier layer for enhanced derivative learning, and a hybrid optimization integrating neural operators with numerical solvers.
summary_en.result: The hybrid approach achieves robust convergence on benchmark PDE optimization problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including Poisson and Burgers' equation optimization.

title: History-Aware Neural Operator: Robust Data-Driven Constitutive Modeling of Path-Dependent Materials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的历史感知神经算子（HANO）可高效模拟路径依赖材料，其框架可直接迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, nor does it address constraints or uncertainty quantification in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统RNN模型在路径依赖材料建模中存在自洽性和初始状态敏感性问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于傅里叶神经算子的自回归模型HANO，嵌入层次自注意力机制捕捉多尺度特征。
summary_zh.result: 在弹塑性和渐进损伤基准问题上，HANO在预测精度、泛化性和鲁棒性上优于基线模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过弹塑性硬化和脆性材料渐进损伤两个数值基准问题验证。

summary_en.motivation: Recurrent neural network models for path-dependent materials suffer from self-consistency issues and sensitivity to initial hidden states.
summary_en.method: HANO is an autoregressive Fourier neural operator with hierarchical self-attention that predicts stress-strain evolution from short history segments without hidden state variables.
summary_en.result: HANO outperforms baseline models in accuracy, generalization, and robustness on elastoplasticity and progressive damage benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two numerical benchmark problems: elastoplasticity with hardening and progressive anisotropic damage in brittle solids.

title: An Attention-based Spatio-Temporal Neural Operator for Evolving Physics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的注意力时空神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决变环境参数下的高效仿真问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on any biomedical or implant mechanics FEA problem, nor does it address constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有模型难以泛化到未知环境参数，需可解释且自适应的物理学习模型。
summary_zh.method: 结合分离注意力机制和BDF启发的时间变换器，提出ASNO架构。
summary_zh.result: 在科学机器学习基准上优于现有模型，具备工程应用潜力。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准SciML基准数据集上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable reliable predictions under varying environmental conditions, a model must capture long-range spatio-temporal interactions and adapt to unseen physical parameters.
summary_en.method: ASNO combines separable attention for spatial and temporal interactions with a BDF-inspired transformer for temporal extrapolation and an attention-based neural operator for varying external loads.

title: A decomposition-based robust training of physics-informed neural networks for nearly incompressible linear elasticity

why_not_core: This paper does not include implant-specific geometry, boundary conditions, or experimental validation in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在近不可压缩线弹性中的锁定问题，提高精度和收敛性。
summary_zh.method: 提出分解式PINN框架，将弹性方程重写为平衡子系统以消除病态。

summary_zh.motivation: 从极少数据中学习未知物理的PDE动力学，克服现有方法对大数据或已知物理的依赖。

summary_en.motivation: To learn PDE dynamics from extremely limited data without known physics, overcoming the reliance on large datasets or explicit PDE residuals.
summary_en.method: SINO automatically captures local and global spatial derivatives via frequency indices and models nonlinear effects using a Pi-block with multiplicative spectral features and a low-pass filter.
summary_en.result: On 2D and 3D PDE benchmarks, SINO trained on only 5 trajectories outperforms data-driven methods trained on 1000 trajectories.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical PDE benchmarks including 2D and 3D problems.

summary_en.method: Three porous scaffold designs (uniform, radial-gradient, axial-gradient) were fabricated via 3D printing, mechanically tested, and biologically evaluated; the optimal scaffold was coated with chitosan microspheres loaded with BMP-2, PDGF-BB, or both.
summary_en.result: Radial-gradient scaffolds exhibited bone-matched elastic modulus and superior cell compatibility; dual-growth-factor coating significantly enhanced osteogenic differentiation and new bone formation.
summary_en.validation: Finite element analysis, compression testing, in vitro cell assays, and in vivo animal experiments.

title: GIT-BO: High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization with Tabular Foundation Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于表格基础模型的高维贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程在高维贝叶斯优化中计算成本高且假设脆弱。
summary_zh.method: 利用表格基础模型TabPFN v2进行零样本贝叶斯推断，结合主动子空间和梯度信息。
summary_zh.result: 在多达500维的60个基准问题上，性能-时间权衡优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在20个基准（9个合成族+10个真实任务）上验证，最高500维。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process surrogates suffer from heavy retraining and brittle assumptions in high-dimensional Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: GIT-BO couples TabPFN v2, a tabular foundation model for zero-shot Bayesian inference, with an active-subspace mechanism derived from predictive-mean gradients and Fisher information.
summary_en.result: Across 60 problem variants up to 500 dimensions, GIT-BO achieves superior performance-time trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art GP-based methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 20 benchmarks including 9 scalable synthetic families and 10 real-world tasks (e.g., power systems, Rover, MOPTA08, Mazda).

title: Dual Natural Gradient Descent for Scalable Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的PINN训练方法，能够高效处理大规模网络，对于将PINN应用于生物力学代理模型具有重要参考价值。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有自然梯度法在参数空间求解导致高计算复杂度，限制了大尺度PINN训练。

summary_zh.result: 方法可训练1280万参数网络，最终误差比一阶方法低1-3个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE基准上测试，并与Adam、SGD等方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Natural-gradient methods for PINNs suffer from O(n^3) complexity in parameter space, hindering scalability to large networks.
summary_en.method: Dual Natural Gradient Descent (D-NGD) reformulates the Gauss-Newton step in residual space and adds a geodesic-acceleration correction, with a Nystrom-preconditioned CG solver for large m.
summary_en.result: D-NGD trains PINNs with up to 12.8 million parameters on a single GPU, achieving 1-3 orders of magnitude lower L^2 error than first-order and quasi-Newton methods.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems comparing against Adam, SGD, and L-BFGS.

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Extended Fiducial Inference
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于扩展fiducial推断的PINN不确定性量化方法，可应用于生物力学代理模型中的不确定性评估。

summary_zh.validation: 理论推导，未进行数值或实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing UQ methods for PINNs rely on priors or dropout rates, failing to construct honest confidence sets without additional information.
summary_en.method: A narrow-neck hyper-network learns PINN parameters and quantifies uncertainty via imputed random errors in observations within the extended fiducial inference framework.
summary_en.result: The approach enables honest confidence sets solely from observed data, overcoming limitations of Bayesian and dropout methods.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical derivation without numerical benchmarks or experimental validation.

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods rely on regular grids, limiting their applicability to complex irregular domains.
summary_en.method: This work proposes a Graph-based Operator Learning with Attention (GOLA) framework that constructs graphs from irregularly sampled points and uses attention-enhanced GNNs with a Fourier encoder for flexible embeddings.
summary_en.result: The method consistently outperforms baselines on 2D PDEs including Darcy Flow and Advection, particularly under data-scarce regimes.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on multiple PDEs with varying sampling densities demonstrate strong generalization and efficiency on irregular domains.

title: Geometry Aware Operator Transformer as an Efficient and Accurate Neural Surrogate for PDEs on Arbitrary Domains
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的几何感知算子变压器（GAOT）能够高效准确地学习任意域上的PDE解算子，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决昂贵采样效率问题。

summary_zh.method: 提出几何感知算子变压器，结合多尺度图神经算子编码器、几何嵌入和视觉变压器处理器
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE学习任务上实现了准确性和效率的显著提升，并在三维工业CFD数据集上达到最优
summary_zh.validation: 在多个PDE基准任务和三个大规模三维工业CFD数据集上验证

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods for PDEs often trade off accuracy for computational efficiency, motivating a model that excels at both.
summary_en.method: A geometry-aware operator transformer (GAOT) is proposed, integrating multiscale attentional graph neural operator encoders/decoders, geometry embeddings, and vision transformer processors.
summary_en.result: GAOT achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on diverse PDE learning tasks, including three large-scale 3D industrial CFD datasets.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on multiple PDE benchmarks and three large-scale 3D industrial CFD datasets, comparing against several baselines.

title: TI-DeepONet: Learnable Time Integration for Stable Long-Term Extrapolation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的时间积分算子学习方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的长期预测问题，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。

summary_zh.method: 将学习目标从状态预测转为瞬时导数近似，结合自适应数值时间步进

summary_zh.validation: 在混沌、耗散、色散和高维PDE上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the error accumulation in neural operators for long-term temporal extrapolation of dynamical systems.
summary_en.method: Shift learning from direct state prediction to approximating instantaneous time-derivative fields, integrated with adaptive numerical time-stepping and learnable coefficients for multi-stage integrators.
summary_en.result: Achieves 96.3% reduction in extrapolation error over autoregressive methods and 83.6% over fixed-horizon approaches, with stable predictions up to twice the training horizon.

title: Repulsive Ensembles for Bayesian Inference in Physics-informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于排斥集成的方法来改进物理信息神经网络的不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any biomedical or implant design problem, nor does it address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.result: 排斥集成比标准集成产生更准确的不确定性估计和更高的样本多样性
summary_zh.validation: 与蒙特卡洛基线比较，在多个基准问题上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve uncertainty quantification in physics-informed neural networks for inverse problems, where standard ensembles collapse to point estimates.
summary_en.method: A repulsive term is added to the loss function of ensemble PINNs, ensuring that the ensemble predictions converge to the true Bayesian posterior in the limit of infinite members.
summary_en.result: The repulsive ensemble yields significantly more accurate uncertainty estimates and higher sample diversity compared to standard ensembles.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks against Monte Carlo baselines.

title: Guided Diffusion Sampling on Function Spaces with Applications to PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在函数空间中进行条件扩散采样的框架，可高效解决PDE逆问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模与不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently recover full PDE solutions from extremely sparse or noisy observations in inverse problems.
summary_en.method: Proposes FunDPS, a function-space diffusion model with neural operator architectures and gradient-based guidance for conditional sampling.

title: Generating Full-field Evolution of Physical Dynamics from Irregular Sparse Observations

summary_en.motivation: To reconstruct full-field physical dynamics from sparse and irregular observations, overcoming the limitations of grid-based methods.
summary_en.method: SDIFT uses a functional Tucker model as a latent representation and a sequential diffusion model with temporally augmented UNet to generate core tensor sequences.
summary_en.result: The method achieves superior reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency on astronomical, environmental, and molecular systems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three physical systems: supernova explosions, ocean sound speed fields, and organic liquids, using simulation data.

title: Sensitivity-Constrained Fourier Neural Operators for Forward and Inverse Problems in Parametric Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的灵敏度约束傅里叶神经算子可高效求解参数化微分方程的正反问题，其方法可直接迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模与不确定性量化。

summary_en.result: SC-FNO achieves superior accuracy in forward prediction and parameter inversion, scales to high-dimensional parameters, and reduces data requirements.

title: Full-field surrogate modeling of cardiac function encoding geometric variability
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合几何变异的全场代理模型方法，可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的高效仿真与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on cardiac electrophysiology surrogate modeling, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决心脏功能代理模型对几何形状的依赖，实现跨患者泛化。

summary_zh.result: 在13例法洛四联症患者数据上实现平均无量纲均方误差0.0034。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the geometry-specific limitation of cardiac surrogate models and enable generalization across patients with varying anatomies.
summary_en.method: A pipeline combining Branched Latent Neural Maps with large deformation diffeomorphic metric mapping and z-score sampling from statistical shape models to encode geometric variability into full-field surrogates.
summary_en.result: The surrogate model achieved an average adimensional mean squared error of 0.0034 on a challenging cohort of 13 pediatric Tetralogy of Fallot patients.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed on numerical simulations of electrophysiology using a synthetic cohort of 52 geometries and the original patient cohort.

title: Temporal Neural Operator for Modeling Time-Dependent Physical Phenomena
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的时间神经算子（TNO）可高效学习时变PDE的时空映射，其方法可直接迁移至生物力学中植入物-骨界面的瞬态力学仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on any biomedical or implant mechanics problem, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address multi-objective constraints in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子难以准确捕捉时变PDE的时间动态，且训练成本高。
summary_zh.method: 提出时间神经算子（TNO），在DeepONet框架中引入时间分支，结合马尔可夫假设、教师强制和时间捆绑等策略。
summary_zh.result: TNO在长时间外推、误差累积鲁棒性、分辨率不变性和多输入函数处理上表现优异。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个基准问题（如波动方程、对流扩散方程）的数值实验和消融研究进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle to capture temporal dynamics of time-dependent PDEs and are computationally expensive to train.
summary_en.method: The Temporal Neural Operator (TNO) extends DeepONet with a temporal branch and incorporates training strategies such as Markov assumption, teacher forcing, and temporal bundling.
summary_en.result: TNO demonstrates superior long-range temporal extrapolation, robustness to error accumulation, resolution invariance, and flexibility in handling multiple input functions.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical benchmarks on diverse time-dependent PDEs (e.g., wave equation, advection-diffusion) and an ablation study confirm the method's effectiveness.

summary_en.motivation: Traditional numerical methods are computationally expensive for repeated PDE evaluations, motivating the need for efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: GINOT integrates transformer architecture with neural operator framework, using a sampling and grouping strategy with attention mechanism to encode arbitrary geometry point clouds.
summary_en.result: The model achieves high accuracy and strong generalization on multiple challenging 2D and 3D geometry datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark datasets, demonstrating accuracy and generalization across complex geometries.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational burden of finite element analysis in cardiac biomechanics for clinical digital twin applications.
summary_en.method: An attention-enhanced graph neural network (HeartSimSage) is developed to emulate FEA, incorporating Laplace-Dirichlet spatial encoding and subset-based training.
summary_en.result: HeartSimSage achieves approximately 13,000x speedup on GPU with a mean displacement error of 0.13%.

summary_en.result: The framework outperforms traditional methods in modeling 3D heart electrodynamics, demonstrating improved prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on a 3D heart geometry validate the approach against baselines without geometric information or active learning.

summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive or superior performance on aerodynamic and structural benchmarks compared to graph-based, neural operator, and neural field methods, with real-time inference and efficient scaling to high-resolution meshes.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks from aerodynamics and structural mechanics, comparing against multiple baseline methods.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于不确定性的自适应混合模型，可显著降低多尺度模拟的数据采集成本，对生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真加速具有直接借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include any biomedical context or experimental validation.

summary_zh.result: 该方法在保持精度的同时显著减少数据收集时间，并保证数值稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过弹塑性材料的高斯过程代理模型进行数值模拟验证。

summary_en.motivation: Training data-driven surrogates for multiscale models requires large datasets covering all load scenarios, which is computationally prohibitive.
summary_en.method: An adaptive mixture approach is introduced, using a phase-field model driven by surrogate uncertainty to locally switch between a fast probabilistic surrogate and the high-fidelity model.
summary_en.result: The method significantly reduces data collection time while maintaining high accuracy and numerical stability.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via simulation of an elasto-plastic material using a Gaussian Process surrogate.

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators suffer from computational inefficiency on large-scale meshes and accuracy degradation on irregular domains.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Subspace Parameterized Attention (SUPRA) mechanism that approximates attention in function spaces using Laplacian eigenfunctions to construct a finite-dimensional subspace on irregular domains.
summary_en.result: SUPRA reduces error rates by up to 33% on various PDE datasets while maintaining state-of-the-art computational efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard PDE benchmark datasets including Darcy flow, Navier-Stokes, and elastic wave propagation.

title: Predicting Stress and Damage in Carbon Fiber-Reinforced Composites Deformation Process using Composite U-Net Surrogate Model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的复合U-Net代理模型可同时预测应力与损伤场，其自回归架构和空间特征捕捉能力对生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模具有高度可迁移性。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific geometry; it focuses on composite material microstructures under unidirectional strain.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统FEM模拟复合材料变形计算效率低，现有代理模型无法全面捕捉应力与损伤演化。
summary_zh.method: 提出自回归复合U-Net深度学习模型，同时预测CFRC变形过程中的应力与损伤场。
summary_zh.result: 模型在预测微观结构应力与损伤分布上达到高精度，速度提升超过60倍。
summary_zh.validation: 与IGFEM数值基准对比验证预测精度与加速比。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional FEM simulations for carbon fiber-reinforced composites are computationally expensive, and existing surrogate models fail to capture the full evolution of stress and damage during deformation.
summary_en.method: An auto-regressive composite U-Net deep learning model is proposed to simultaneously predict stress and damage fields in CFRC microstructures under unidirectional strain.
summary_en.result: The model achieves high accuracy in predicting stress and damage distributions, with a speed-up of over 60 times compared to IGFEM.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing predictions against IGFEM numerical benchmarks.

title: Integrating Locality-Aware Attention with Transformers for General Geometry PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合局部与全局注意力的Transformer神经算子，适用于不规则几何上的PDE求解，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address constrained optimization.

summary_zh.method: 提出LA2Former，通过K近邻动态分块并融合全局-局部注意力。
summary_zh.result: 在六个基准上预测精度比线性注意力方法提升50%以上。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准数据集上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Transformer-based neural operators emphasize global features but neglect fine-scale dynamics, limiting accuracy on irregular geometries.
summary_en.method: The Locality-Aware Attention Transformer (LA2Former) uses K-nearest neighbors for dynamic patchifying and combines linear attention with pairwise attention for efficient global-local encoding.
summary_en.result: LA2Former improves predictive accuracy by over 50% compared to linear attention methods on six benchmark PDE datasets.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard numerical PDE benchmarks including complex and irregular domain problems.

Note that in this context, a patch refers not to a contiguous spatial division, as in an image, but rather to a set of neighbors defined by distance. The resulting tensor serves as a key input for learning local neighborhood information in subsequent stages.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理循环神经网络（PRNN）能够在不重新训练的情况下处理材料参数变化，并实现多尺度不确定性量化，其方法可直接迁移到植入物/生物力学设计中的代理建模与不确定性传播问题。

summary_zh.result: 收敛速度提升20%，误差低于3%，无需细网格即可降低计算成本。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证收敛性和精度。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional PDE solvers struggle with balancing computational cost and accuracy, while neural operators suffer from large data requirements and error accumulation in time-dependent simulations.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework integrating physics-informed DeepONet with FEM via domain decomposition and Schwarz iteration, with a time stepping scheme embedded in the DeepONet to reduce long-term error.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves up to 20% improvement in convergence rates and maintains solution fidelity with errors below 3%, eliminating the need for fine meshes.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark tests demonstrate accelerated convergence and accuracy compared to conventional FE coupling approaches.

title: Enabling Automatic Differentiation with Mollified Graph Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的mGNO方法利用自动微分在任意几何上精确计算PDE导数，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，提高采样效率和约束处理能力。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有物理信息神经算子依赖有限差分或谱方法求导，存在近似误差且难以处理不规则网格。
summary_zh.method: 提出mollified图神经算子（mGNO），利用自动微分在任意几何上精确计算梯度。
summary_zh.result: 在规则网格上误差降低20倍，在无结构点云上误差比基线低两个数量级，求解速度比数值求解器快1-3个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在规则网格和无结构点云上的PDE基准测试中验证，并与Meta-PDE等基线比较。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural operators suffer from derivative approximation errors due to finite difference or spectral methods, limiting accuracy on irregular geometries.
summary_en.method: The mollified graph neural operator (mGNO) enables automatic differentiation on arbitrary geometries, computing exact gradients for physics losses.
summary_en.result: mGNO reduces L2 relative data error by 20x on regular grids and achieves two orders of magnitude lower error than baselines on unstructured point clouds, with speedups of 1-3 orders of magnitude over numerical solvers.
summary_en.validation: Validated on PDE benchmarks with regular and unstructured grids, compared against finite differences and Meta-PDE baselines.

title: Multiobjective Optimization under Uncertainties using Conditional Pareto Fronts
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的条件帕累托前沿主动学习方法直接解决了多目标优化中的不确定性问题，可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks validation on expensive simulation-based optimization problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决参数不确定性下的多目标优化问题，提高设计鲁棒性。

summary_zh.result: 在中等维度玩具问题和客舱设计问题中展示了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准和客舱设计案例验证方法。

summary_en.motivation: To address multiobjective optimization under parametric uncertainties by defining conditional Pareto sets and fronts for robust design.
summary_en.method: An active learning method based on Gaussian process regression and a reformulation of the expected hypervolume improvement is introduced to efficiently estimate the probability of coverage of the conditional Pareto set.
summary_en.result: The method is demonstrated on moderate-dimensional toy problems and a cabin design problem, highlighting differences in solutions under various uncertainty formulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and a cabin design case study.

title: ConfEviSurrogate: A Conformalized Evidential Surrogate Model for Uncertainty Quantification

summary_en.motivation: Existing surrogate models lack rigorous uncertainty quantification with guaranteed coverage, leading to unreliable predictions in simulation-based science.
summary_en.method: ConfEviSurrogate integrates evidential learning for high-order distribution prediction with conformal prediction calibration to ensure valid prediction intervals.
summary_en.result: The model achieves accurate point predictions and robust uncertainty estimates across diverse simulations including cosmology, ocean dynamics, and fluid dynamics.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple numerical simulation benchmarks, demonstrating improved coverage and efficiency over existing methods.

title: Multi-fidelity Parameter Estimation Using Conditional Diffusion Models

summary_en.motivation: Traditional Bayesian parameter estimation requires repeated expensive high-fidelity simulations, leading to computationally intractable workflows and inability to adapt to new observations.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity conditional diffusion model is proposed, where a low-fidelity generative model performs amortized inference, followed by adaptive refinement to train a high-fidelity unconditional generative model for accurate posterior sampling.
summary_en.result: The method achieves efficient and accurate posterior sampling on numerical examples with multi-modal densities and a plasma physics application.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including multi-modal densities and a runaway electron simulation model in plasma physics.
