title: The 3D-Printed Customized Femoral Short Stem Offers Improved Anatomical Parameters Restoration, Fitness and Biomechanical Performance Compared With Traditional Femoral Stem
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接比较了3D打印定制短柄与传统假体在股骨近端应力分布、微动和贴合度方面的生物力学性能，与用户研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include patient-specific FE modeling or population-based analysis, and does not report strain/stress in Gruen zones.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统股骨柄不适用于严重骨缺损患者，3D打印定制柄可改善贴合与初始稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 使用人工股骨模型进行体外THA模拟，对比3D打印定制短柄与Trilock柄的解剖参数、贴合度、微动和应变分布。
summary_zh.result: 定制柄的颈干角和冠状面水平偏移更接近完整股骨，贴合度更好，微动更小。
summary_zh.validation: 通过3D数字图像相关测量系统在不同模拟体重载荷下记录微动和应变。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional femoral stems are unsuitable for patients with severe proximal femoral bone defects, and 3D-printed customized designs may improve canal contact and initial stability.
summary_en.method: An in vitro study using artificial femur models compared a 3D-printed customized femoral short stem with a Trilock stem, evaluating anatomical parameters, fitness, micromotion, and strain distribution under simulated bodyweight loading via 3D digital image correlation.
summary_en.result: The customized stem achieved neck-shaft angle and coronal femoral horizontal offset closer to the intact femur, superior cross-sectional fitness, and reduced micromotion under all loading conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing on artificial femurs using a 3D digital image correlation system to measure micromotion and strain.

title: Scaffold geometries designed to promote bone ingrowth by enhancing mechanobiological stimulation and biotransportation - A multiobjective optimisation approach.
venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials
first_author_affiliation: School of Aerospace, Mechanical and Mechatronic Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, The University of Sydney, NSW, 2006, Australia. Electronic address: Ben.Ferguson@sydney.edu.au.

corresponding_authors.name: Ben M Ferguson
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Aerospace, Mechanical and Mechatronic Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, The University of Sydney, NSW, 2006, Australia. Electronic address: Ben.Ferguson@sydney.edu.au.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对骨支架几何优化，使用代理模型（响应面）加速多目标优化，与用户方向中的FEA代理建模和约束优化高度相关。
why_not_core: The paper uses simple polynomial response surfaces rather than advanced neural surrogates, and does not include uncertainty quantification or validation on implant-level biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速骨支架内新骨长入过程，缩短愈合时间
summary_zh.method: 基于Schwarz P曲面参数化，结合FE和CFD仿真构建响应面代理模型，进行多目标优化
summary_zh.result: 获得了力学刺激与渗透性之间的最佳权衡设计
summary_zh.validation: 通过羊下颌骨CT有限元模型和CFD模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate bone ingrowth in tissue-engineered scaffolds by optimizing unit cell geometry for mechanobiological stimulation and biotransport.
summary_en.method: Parametric variation of Schwarz P surface unit cells (iso-value and spatial period) combined with FE and CFD simulations to build bivariate cubic polynomial response surfaces for multiobjective optimization.
summary_en.result: The optimized scaffold geometry achieves a trade-off between mechanobiological stimulus and permeability, potentially enhancing tissue regeneration.
summary_en.validation: Validation via a reconstructed sheep mandible CT-based FE model and a CFD model of a 5×5×5 unit cell scaffold.

title: In-vivo and ex-vivo evaluation of bio-inspired structures fabricated via PBF-LB for biomedical applications.
first_author_affiliation: Bio-inspired Processes and Materials Research Group, Instituto Tecnológico de Costa Rica, Cartago, 30101, Costa Rica.; Future Manufacturing Technologies Research Group, University of Oulu, Oulu, 90014, Finland.

corresponding_authors.name: Teodolito Guillén
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Bio-inspired Processes and Materials Research Group, Instituto Tecnológico de Costa Rica, Cartago, 30101, Costa Rica.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接评估了LPBF制造的生物启发多孔结构（TPMS Gyroid和随机点阵）的力学性能、表面处理效果以及体内骨整合和推出力测试，与用户研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report fatigue behavior or surface roughness/as-built morphology in detail.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估生物启发多孔结构在体内外的力学与生物学性能，以改善植入物性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过LPBF制造Ti64 TPMS Gyroid和随机点阵，并进行化学蚀刻后处理，在体内（马模型）和体外进行力学与生物学测试。
summary_zh.result: Gyroid结构具有最高弹性模量和屈服强度，蚀刻后推出力最大，能量吸收优异，且两种结构均表现出良好骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 体内马模型植入和体外推出试验验证了力学与生物学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the mechanical and biological performance of bio-inspired lattice structures fabricated via LPBF for improving biomedical implant functionality.
summary_en.method: Ti64 TPMS Gyroid and Stochastic lattice structures were fabricated using PBF-LB, chemically etched, and characterized mechanically; in-vivo implantation in horse models and ex-vivo push-out tests were conducted.
summary_en.result: The Gyroid lattice exhibited the highest elastic modulus (3.64 GPa) and yield strength (200.65 MPa) post-etching, and the highest push-out force (1645.407 N) and energy absorption (4920.425 mJ), with both structures showing excellent biocompatibility and osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: In-vivo horse model and ex-vivo push-out tests validated mechanical and biological performance.

title: Biomechanical assessment of total hip replacement designs: A comparative study
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接比较了四种髋关节假体设计的生物力学性能，包括应力遮挡、微动和骨密度变化，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not provide detailed finite element boundary conditions or contact modeling parameters for reuse in independent FE work.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较四种髋关节假体设计的生物力学性能，指导个体化假体选择。
summary_zh.method: 对169名患者进行RSA、DXA和有限元验证的应力遮挡指数分析。
summary_zh.result: 骨水泥型假体微动和应力遮挡最小，短柄非骨水泥型最大。
summary_zh.validation: 临床患者数据结合有限元模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the biomechanical performance of four contemporary hip replacement designs and identify patient-specific factors guiding implant selection.
summary_en.method: Radiostereometric analysis, dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry, and finite element-validated stress shielding indices were evaluated in 169 patients at six and twelve months postoperatively.
summary_en.result: Cemented collarless polished taper stems exhibited the lowest micromotion and stress shielding, while short stem cementless implants showed the highest micromotion and subsidence.
summary_en.validation: Clinical patient data with finite element model validation of stress shielding indices.

title: UP-dROM : Uncertainty-Aware and Parametrised dynamic Reduced-Order Model, application to unsteady flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合不确定性量化和参数化的非线性降阶模型，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on unsteady fluid flows, not solid mechanics or implant biomechanics, and lacks validation on biomedical FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高降阶模型在瞬态流场中的鲁棒性和参数化能力。
summary_zh.method: 使用变分自编码器进行不确定性量化，结合注意力机制的潜在空间变换器预测动力学。
summary_zh.result: 模型能提供置信度并利用其高效采样参数空间，提升全参数域性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值仿真案例验证模型预测与不确定性估计。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a reduced-order model that generalizes across transient flow regimes while providing uncertainty estimates for robust engineering decisions.
summary_en.method: A nonlinear reduction strategy combining a variational autoencoder for confidence measurement and a latent-space transformer with attention mechanisms for parameterized dynamical system prediction.
summary_en.result: The model yields predictions with confidence, enabling cost-effective parameter space sampling and improved performance across the entire domain without full evaluation data.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical simulation cases of unsteady fluid flows, demonstrating prediction accuracy and uncertainty quantification.

visual.caption: Figure 2 : Predicted kinetic energy signal using UP-dROM compared with the ground truth.

title: Generative Latent Neural PDE Solver using Flow Matching
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的潜在扩散模型用于PDE求解，可降低计算成本并处理复杂几何，对生物力学代理模型构建具有高度可迁移性。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks constraint handling and multi-objective optimization, and does not demonstrate transfer to biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低扩散模型在PDE求解中的计算开销并适应不规则网格。
summary_zh.method: 提出潜在扩散模型，用自编码器将不同网格映射到统一潜在空间，结合流匹配噪声调度。
summary_zh.result: 在精度和长期稳定性上优于确定性基线。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of diffusion-based neural PDE solvers and extend their applicability to irregular domains.
summary_en.method: A latent diffusion model is proposed that uses an autoencoder to map various meshes onto a unified structured latent grid and employs a coarsely sampled noise schedule from flow matching.
summary_en.result: The proposed model outperforms deterministic baselines in accuracy and long-term stability on numerical PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical PDE benchmarks (e.g., Navier-Stokes, Burgers).

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Main architecture of the proposed latent neural solver based on flow matching. The input data is projected onto a unified latent space via encoder. In the latent space, the diffusion model iteratively transform the noise into the latent state of future timestep. The latent embedding can be projected back to the original mesh space via the decoder.

title: EquiNO: A Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Multiscale Simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的EquiNO方法通过硬约束平衡条件，显著加速多尺度模拟，可直接应用于生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or handle constraints beyond equilibrium.

summary_zh.motivation: 多尺度模拟计算成本高，需要高效且物理一致的代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出EquiNO，通过POD投影硬约束平衡条件，结合有限元与算子学习。
summary_zh.result: 相比传统方法加速超8000倍，在有限数据集上仍保持准确。
summary_zh.validation: 在固体力学准静态问题上进行数值模拟验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multiscale simulations are computationally prohibitive for many-query scenarios, motivating the development of efficient and physically consistent surrogate models.
summary_en.method: EquiNO hard-enforces equilibrium by projecting solutions onto divergence-free POD basis functions, integrating finite element method with operator learning.
summary_en.result: The method achieves speedup factors exceeding 8000-fold over traditional methods while maintaining accuracy even with limited training data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on quasi-static solid mechanics problems using numerical simulation cases.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : A schematic view of the EquiNO architecture.

title: Structural Optimization of 3D-Printed Porous Titanium Implants Promotes Bone Regeneration for Enhanced Biological Fixation.
first_author_affiliation: National Engineering Research Center for Biomaterials, College of Biomedical Engineering, Sichuan University, Chengdu 610064, Sichuan, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Changchun Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: National Engineering Research Center for Biomaterials, College of Biomedical Engineering, Sichuan University, Chengdu 610064, Sichuan, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了3D打印多孔钛合金植入物的结构优化及其对骨再生和生物固定的增强作用，与用户关注的AM生物医学材料方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing or detailed surface roughness/as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 钛合金植入物与骨组织整合差导致螺钉松动，需优化结构促进骨再生。
summary_zh.method: 3D打印制备结构优化的多孔椎弓根螺钉，并构建生物活性涂层。
summary_zh.result: 优化结构具有优异力学性能，促进细胞粘附和骨长入，增强生物固定。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验和比格犬体内植入验证骨整合效果。

summary_en.motivation: Poor integration of titanium alloy implants with bone tissue leads to screw loosening, necessitating structural optimization to enhance bone regeneration.
summary_en.method: 3D-printed porous pedicle screws with optimized unit structures were fabricated and coated with a bioactive sodium titanate layer via alkali-thermal activation.
summary_en.result: The optimized porous structure exhibited superior mechanical properties, promoted cell adhesion and osteogenic differentiation, and enhanced bone ingrowth and osseointegration in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro BMSC assays and in vivo beagle vertebrae implantation confirmed enhanced biological fixation and bone regeneration.

title: 3D Neural Operator-Based Flow Surrogates around 3D geometries: Signed Distance Functions and Derivative Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于SDF的几何编码和导数约束策略可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决高维设计空间中的采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics surrogates, not solid mechanics or implant FEA, and lacks uncertainty quantification and biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真3D流场模拟计算成本高，亟需高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 采用Geometric-DeepONet结合SDF编码几何信息，并引入导数约束损失函数。
summary_zh.result: Geometric-DeepONet边界层精度提升32%，导数约束使外推梯度精度提升45%。
summary_zh.validation: 基于1000个3D流场仿真数据，进行随机和外推测试集验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity 3D flow simulations are computationally expensive, motivating the development of efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: Geometric-DeepONet encodes geometry via signed distance functions and augments loss with velocity gradient penalties and incompressibility constraints.
summary_en.result: Geometric-DeepONet improves boundary-layer accuracy by 32%, and derivative constraints enhance gradient accuracy by up to 45% in extrapolation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a dataset of 1,000 high-fidelity 3D flow simulations with random and extrapolatory train-test splits.

title: Tensor-decomposition-based A Priori Surrogate (TAPS) modeling for ultra large-scale simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种数据无关的代理模型方法，可大幅加速超大规模仿真，其张量分解与AI增强有限元技术对生物力学植入物设计中的高效仿真具有高度可迁移性。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific geometry; it focuses on general ultra large-scale simulations with an additive manufacturing example.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决超大规模工程仿真计算成本过高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于张量分解的先验代理模型(TAPS)，结合AI增强有限元插值函数
summary_zh.result: 在增材制造仿真中实现1370倍加速、14.8倍内存节省和955倍存储节省
summary_zh.validation: 通过增材制造大规模仿真案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the prohibitive computational cost of ultra large-scale engineering simulations with billions of degrees of freedom.
summary_en.method: A data-free surrogate model, TAPS, is proposed using tensor decomposition and a convolution hierarchical deep-learning neural network (C-HiDeNN) to directly obtain reduced-order models from governing equations.
summary_en.result: TAPS achieves approximately 1370x speedup, 14.8x memory savings, and 955x storage gain compared to finite difference methods for a large-scale additive manufacturing simulation with 3.46 billion spatial DOFs.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated through a simulation case of additive manufacturing, demonstrating significant computational gains.

title: MIXPINN: Mixed-Material Simulations by Physics-Informed Neural Network
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的MIXPINN框架直接解决了生物力学中软硬材料相互作用的快速仿真问题，与用户关注的FEA替代模型和植入物设计高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific mechanics such as stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统FEM模拟软硬材料相互作用计算昂贵，无法实时应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出MIXPINN，利用图神经网络结合虚拟节点和虚拟边来建模软硬交互。
summary_zh.result: 实现亚毫米精度实时推理，计算成本降低一个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在真实临床场景中与FEM和基线GNN对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional FEM simulations of soft-rigid interactions are computationally prohibitive for real-time surgical applications.
summary_en.method: MIXPINN employs a physics-informed graph neural network with virtual nodes and edges to capture soft-rigid interactions efficiently.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves sub-millimeter accuracy in real-time inference, reducing computational cost by an order of magnitude.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a realistic clinical scenario, comparing against FEM and baseline GNN models.

title: A novel solution for real-time

relevance_to_user: 该论文将实时荧光成像与可见光成像结合，实现了生物打印过程中细胞分布的自动监测，直接支持AI驱动的打印过程控制。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI/ML into the monitoring workflow; it focuses on hardware integration and data acquisition without autonomous decision-making or predictive modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 生物打印中缺乏实时监测细胞分布的方法，影响打印质量。
summary_zh.method: 集成紧凑型荧光显微镜与可见光成像，实现逐层原位监测。
summary_zh.result: 成功实时检测细胞分散异常，支持即时纠正。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外生物打印实验验证成像与监测效果。

summary_en.motivation: Real-time monitoring of cell distribution during bioprinting is critical for construct quality but remains underdeveloped.
summary_en.method: A compact fluorescence microscopy system integrated into a commercial bioprinter captures layer-by-layer cell dispersion images, fused with visible spectrum data.
summary_en.result: The system enables continuous detection of irregularities in cell deposition, allowing immediate correction during printing.
summary_en.validation: In vitro bioprinting experiments demonstrated the feasibility and accuracy of the monitoring approach.

title: In-vitro measurements coupled with in-silico simulations for stochastic calibration and uncertainty quantification of the mechanical response of biological materials
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对生物材料力学响应的随机校准与不确定性量化，方法可迁移至植入物设计中的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: Does not address implant-specific design optimization or constraint handling, and focuses on tendon material characterization rather than implant-bone interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决生物材料力学响应中参数校准与不确定性量化的难题。
summary_zh.method: 结合体外测量与基于似然自由贝叶斯推断的有限元模拟进行随机校准。
summary_zh.result: 后验参数能捕捉体外测量的不确定性边界。
summary_zh.validation: 通过人体跟腱标本的多种加载实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a practical framework for stochastic calibration and uncertainty quantification of mechanical response in biological materials without requiring a likelihood function.
summary_en.method: Couples in-vitro measurements with in-silico simulations using likelihood-free Bayesian inference (approximate Bayesian computation) and finite element method.
summary_en.result: Posterior parameters from approximate Bayesian computation successfully capture the uncertainty bounds of in-vitro measurements across multiple loading conditions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on human Achilles tendon specimens from diabetic patients under one-step, two-step relaxation, and incremental cyclic loading tests.

title: PIED: Physics-Informed Experimental Design for Inverse Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息实验设计框架可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, contact mechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on general PDE inverse problems without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决有限预算下基于PDE逆问题的实验设计计算瓶颈。
summary_zh.method: 利用PINN全微分架构进行一次性实验设计参数连续优化，结合元学习初始化。
summary_zh.result: 在噪声模拟和真实数据上显著优于现有实验设计方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过含噪模拟数据和真实实验数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome computational bottlenecks in experimental design for PDE-based inverse problems under limited observation budgets.
summary_en.method: Proposes PIED, a fully differentiable framework using physics-informed neural networks with meta-learned initialization for one-shot continuous optimization of design parameters.
summary_en.result: PIED significantly outperforms existing experimental design methods on noisy simulated and real-world data, including functional inverse parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validated on noisy simulated data and real-world experimental data from a PDE system.

title: Active operator learning with predictive uncertainty quantification for partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种轻量级的不确定性量化方法用于神经算子，可提高代理模型在偏微分方程求解中的采样效率，并支持主动学习，对生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, nor does it handle multi-objective constraints typical in implant optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子预测误差未知，需轻量级不确定性量化方法以部署可靠代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于DeepONet的预测性不确定性量化框架，结合预计算和稀疏矩阵实现快速推理。
summary_zh.result: 不确定性估计无偏，在主动学习和贝叶斯优化中提高数据效率和精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在线性和非线性偏微分方程数值实验上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operator predictions lack error quantification, necessitating a lightweight uncertainty quantification method for deploying reliable surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A predictive uncertainty quantification framework tailored for DeepONets is proposed, leveraging precomputed trunk outputs and sparse placement matrices for fast inference.
summary_en.result: The uncertainty estimates are unbiased and improve accuracy and data-efficiency in active learning and Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical experiments of linear and nonlinear PDEs.

title: Active Learning for Deep Learning-Based Hemodynamic Parameter Estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习框架可显著减少CFD仿真数据需求，适用于生物力学代理模型的构建，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on hemodynamic parameter estimation in idealized geometries.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少CFD仿真数据需求，降低代理模型部署门槛
summary_zh.method: 提出三种主动学习查询策略（几何方差、集成不确定性、物理约束）选择样本

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators lack uncertainty quantification, limiting their use in complex, chaotic systems.

summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks across different domains against multiple baselines.

title: Optimal morphings for model-order reduction for poorly reducible problems with geometric variability

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the slow decay of Kolmogorov N-width in parametric PDEs with geometric variability, which hinders standard linear subspace model-order reduction.
summary_en.method: An optimal morphing strategy is proposed that computes bijective mappings from a reference domain to sample domains via global optimization, maximizing the energy captured by the first POD modes, followed by Gaussian process regression on reduced coordinates.
summary_en.result: The framework yields accurate surrogate predictions for new geometries, demonstrating practical benefits for many-query applications.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on parametric PDEs with geometric variability validate the reducibility improvement and surrogate accuracy.

why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks validation on implant-specific constraints or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统逆设计计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 利用动态模态分解构建低秩子空间实现快速逆设计
summary_zh.result: 比竞争方法精度高一个量级，速度快3-5个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 在结构振动和流体动力学工程问题上验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a computationally efficient inverse design method that overcomes the high cost of traditional optimization.
summary_en.method: The ID-DMD algorithm constructs a low-rank subspace from multiple experiments using dynamic mode decomposition and least-squares regression.
summary_en.result: ID-DMD achieves an order of magnitude higher accuracy and 3-5 orders faster speed than competing methods on engineering design problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on structural vibration and fluid dynamics benchmark problems.

title: A Deep Learning approach for parametrized and time dependent Partial Differential Equations using Dimensionality Reduction and Neural ODEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的降维+神经常微分方程方法可显著加速参数化PDE求解，适用于生物力学有限元代理模型构建。
why_not_core: No application to implant or biomechanics FEA; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification demonstrated.

summary_zh.motivation: 参数化时变PDE求解昂贵，现有深度学习方法缺乏统一框架。
summary_zh.method: 结合降维与神经常微分方程，在低维潜空间学习PDE解的时间演化。
summary_zh.result: 降维策略使模型更轻量、更准确，优于大型复杂架构。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值PDE基准上验证精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: Solving parametric time-dependent PDEs is computationally expensive, and existing deep learning methods lack a unified framework for both time and parameter dependency.
summary_en.method: The proposed method couples dimensionality reduction with neural ODEs to learn the solution operator in a low-dimensional latent space, enabling autoregressive time stepping.
summary_en.result: The dimensionality reduction approach yields lighter and more accurate models compared to large complex architectures, significantly reducing computational cost for repeated PDE solves.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on several numerical PDE benchmarks (e.g., Burgers' equation, advection-diffusion) comparing accuracy and computational efficiency.

title: GraphCompNet: A Position-Aware Model for Predicting and Compensating Shape Deviations in 3D Printing
relevance_to_user: 该论文将图神经网络与GAN结合，用于预测和补偿3D打印中的形状偏差，直接适用于生物打印中的几何精度控制。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve bioprinting-specific materials (bioinks) or biological validation (cell viability, tissue formation).

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法难以泛化到复杂几何和批量生产中的位置依赖偏差。
summary_zh.method: 提出GraphCompNet，结合图神经网络和GAN对抗训练，实现位置感知的偏差预测与补偿。
summary_zh.result: 在多种形状和位置上补偿精度提升35%至65%，适应批量生产条件。
summary_zh.validation: 通过不同几何形状和打印位置的实验验证补偿效果。

summary_en.motivation: Existing methods for shape deviation compensation in additive manufacturing lack generalizability to complex geometries and adaptability to position-dependent variations in batch production.
summary_en.method: GraphCompNet integrates dynamic graph convolutional neural networks with a GAN-inspired compensator-predictor architecture to model and compensate shape deviations using point cloud representations.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves 35% to 65% improvement in compensation accuracy across diverse shapes and positions, effectively addressing position-dependent variabilities within the print chamber.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was conducted on multiple freeform geometries and positions, demonstrating significant reduction in geometric deviations.

title: DGenNO: A Novel Physics-aware Neural Operator for Solving Forward and Inverse PDE Problems based on Deep, Generative Probabilistic Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于深度生成概率模型的物理感知神经算子，能够处理高维不连续输入和逆问题，并具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and lacks validation on implant-specific problems such as stress shielding or micromotion.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子方法难以处理高维不连续输入且需要大量标记数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出深度生成神经算子DGenNO，结合潜变量编码和弱形式物理约束。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上实现更高精度，对噪声鲁棒且泛化能力强。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证，包括多相介质问题。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle with high-dimensional discontinuous inputs and require large labeled datasets, limiting their applicability to forward and inverse PDE problems.
summary_en.method: DGenNO employs a deep generative probabilistic model with latent variables to jointly encode PDE inputs and outputs, and enforces physics constraints via weak-form residuals using compactly supported radial basis functions.
summary_en.result: The method achieves higher accuracy on multiple benchmarks, exhibits robustness to noise, and generalizes well to out-of-distribution cases.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including multi-phase media problems, demonstrating accuracy and robustness.

title: Hybrid Biomechanical Design of Dental Implants: Integrating Solid and Gyroid Triply Periodic Minimal Surface Lattice Architectures for Optimized Stress Distribution.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究牙科植入物的应力遮挡问题，通过混合TPMS点阵结构优化应力分布，与用户关注的AM生物医学方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dental implants rather than hip implants, and does not include LPBF fabrication or experimental mechanical testing (fatigue, surface roughness, osseointegration).

summary_zh.motivation: 传统实心牙科植入物存在应力遮挡问题，影响骨整合和长期稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 设计全点阵和混合点阵（实心颈部+点阵体）的牙科植入物，通过有限元分析评估应力分布和微动。
summary_zh.result: 混合点阵植入物（特别是HI_222）减少了微动，改善了应力分布和骨整合潜力。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过有限元模拟和动态咀嚼载荷验证，无实验测试。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional solid dental implants cause stress shielding, compromising osseointegration and long-term durability.
summary_en.method: Six fully and hybrid gyroid TPMS lattice dental implants with varying cell sizes were designed and evaluated using finite element analysis under dynamic mastication loading.
summary_en.result: Hybrid implants, especially HI_222, reduced micromotions at the bone-implant interface and achieved better stress distribution.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed solely through finite element simulation without experimental mechanical testing.

title: Microscale bone interlocking enhances osseointegration strength on the rough surface of 3D-printed titanium implants: experimental and finite element analysis.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of Shaanxi Province for Craniofacial Precision Medicine Research, College of Stomatology, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Xi'an, 710049, China. peidandan@xjtu.edu.cn.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了3D打印钛植入体的表面粗糙度对骨整合强度的影响，并通过实验和有限元分析揭示了微观骨互锁机制，与用户关于增材制造生物医学植入物的方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not explicitly link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report fatigue testing or as-built morphology beyond surface roughness.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究3D打印钛植入体表面粗糙度增强骨整合强度的生物力学机制。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备实验植入体，进行动物实验和微观有限元分析。
summary_zh.result: 粗糙表面促进微观骨互锁，分散界面应变，提高骨整合强度。
summary_zh.validation: 兔股骨髁植入实验，结合组织学、扭矩测试和有限元分析。

summary_en.motivation: To elucidate the biomechanical mechanisms by which increased surface roughness of 3D-printed titanium implants enhances osseointegration strength.
summary_en.method: Experimental SLM-fabricated implants were compared with conventional CNC-SLA implants via animal experiments and microscale finite element analysis of bone-implant interfaces.
summary_en.result: The rough surface of SLM implants promoted microscale bone interlocking and alleviated peri-implant bone strain concentration, leading to higher removal torque.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rabbit femoral condyle model with histological, removal torque, and micro-CT assessments, supported by finite element analysis.

title: Learning Memory and Material Dependent Constitutive Laws
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子框架可学习记忆和微观结构依赖的本构模型，适用于多尺度模拟，可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific geometry; it focuses on homogenized constitutive laws for heterogeneous materials without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多尺度材料本构模型难以显式评估的问题
summary_zh.method: 结合马尔可夫递归和傅里叶神经算子学习记忆与微观结构依赖的本构模型
summary_zh.result: 准确学习粘弹性和弹-粘塑性本构模型，无需重训练即可用于宏观模拟
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证不同微观结构下的本构预测精度

summary_en.motivation: To learn memory- and microstructure-dependent constitutive laws for heterogeneous materials without explicit evaluation of unit cell problems.
summary_en.method: A neural operator framework combining Markovian recurrent and Fourier neural operators to model homogenized constitutive laws with memory and microstructure dependence.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately learns viscoelastic and elasto-viscoplastic constitutive models and generalizes to macroscale simulations for different microstructures without retraining.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on Kelvin-Voigt viscoelastic and elasto-viscoplastic materials demonstrate accuracy and transferability.

title: Calibrated Physics-Informed Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种物理信息共形预测框架，用于神经PDE模型的不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的设计优化。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, nor does it address multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经PDE模型缺乏可靠的不确定性量化，限制了其在关键应用中的部署。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种模型无关的物理信息共形预测框架，利用物理残差作为非一致性分数实现无数据UQ。
summary_zh.result: 在多个复杂PDE上提供了边际和联合覆盖保证，并在等离子体建模中验证了有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过等离子体建模和聚变反应堆射击设计案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural PDE models lack robust uncertainty quantification, hindering their deployment in critical applications.
summary_en.method: A model-agnostic, physics-informed conformal prediction framework is introduced, using physics residual errors as nonconformity scores for data-free UQ.
summary_en.result: The method provides marginal and joint coverage guarantees across prediction domains for complex PDEs, validated on plasma modeling.
summary_en.validation: Validated on neural PDE models for plasma modeling and shot design in fusion reactors.

title: AL-PINN: Active Learning-Driven Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Efficient Sample Selection in Solving Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对PINN训练样本效率问题，结合主动学习与不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constrained optimization or multi-objective scenarios.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN需要大量训练样本，计算成本高。
summary_zh.method: 提出AL-PINN，利用蒙特卡洛dropout估计不确定性，主动选择高不确定性区域样本。
summary_zh.result: 在基准PDE和气候数据上，以更少样本达到相当或更优精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在已知解析解的基准PDE和WeatherBench气候数据上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs require many training samples for high accuracy, leading to high computational cost.
summary_en.method: AL-PINN integrates Monte Carlo Dropout for epistemic uncertainty estimation and active learning to adaptively select high-uncertainty regions for additional training.
summary_en.result: On benchmark PDEs and WeatherBench data, AL-PINN achieves comparable or superior accuracy with significantly fewer training samples.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark PDE problems with known analytical solutions and real-world WeatherBench climate data.

title: Pseudo-Physics-Informed Neural Operators: Enhancing Operator Learning from Limited Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在数据稀缺情况下增强算子学习的框架，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂应用中数据稀缺导致神经算子训练困难的问题。
summary_zh.method: 构建伪物理系统与神经算子交替更新学习，增强预测能力。
summary_zh.result: 在五个基准任务和疲劳建模中显著提升数据稀缺下的精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准和疲劳建模案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of training neural operators with limited data in complex applications where detailed physics is unavailable.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Pseudo Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PPI-NO) that couples a surrogate physics system with a neural operator via alternating updates.
summary_en.result: PPI-NO significantly improves prediction accuracy of standard operator learning models under data scarcity across five benchmarks and a fatigue modeling task.
summary_en.validation: Validated on five numerical benchmark tasks and a fatigue modeling application.

title: Muti-Fidelity Prediction and Uncertainty Quantification with Laplace Neural Operators for Parametric Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真拉普拉斯神经算子方法可显著降低高保真数据需求并提供不确定性量化，直接适用于用户方向中植入物/生物力学设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper validates only on canonical dynamical systems, not on any biomedical or implant-related FEA problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高保真数据需求，实现参数化PDE的高效代理建模
summary_zh.method: 提出多保真拉普拉斯神经算子，结合低保真基模型与高保真校正器及动态权重
summary_zh.result: 在四个动力系统上测试损失降低40%-80%
summary_zh.validation: 在Lorenz系统、Duffing振子等四个基准系统上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high cost of acquiring high-fidelity training data for neural operators in parametric PDEs.
summary_en.method: Proposes multi-fidelity Laplace Neural Operators (MF-LNO) with parallel linear/nonlinear high-fidelity correctors and dynamic inter-fidelity weighting.
summary_en.result: Achieves 40% to 80% reduction in testing loss across four canonical dynamical systems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on Lorenz system, Duffing oscillator, Burgers equation, and Brusselator reaction-diffusion system.

title: RIGNO: A Graph-based framework for robust and accurate operator learning for PDEs on arbitrary domains
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于图神经网络的算子学习方法，能够处理任意域上的PDE求解，其多尺度架构和分辨率不变性对生物力学有限元代理建模具有很高的迁移潜力。
why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomedical or implant-specific application, nor does it address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or experimental validation in biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子难以处理任意域上的PDE求解，需要一种鲁棒且精确的方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出端到端图神经网络RIGNO，通过下采样区域网格实现多尺度映射，保证时空分辨率不变性。
summary_zh.result: 在多种时变和稳态PDE基准上，RIGNO显著优于现有神经算子基线，并鲁棒泛化到未见分辨率。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE基准数据集上进行数值验证，包括不同域形状和分辨率。

summary_en.motivation: Learning PDE solution operators on arbitrary domains remains challenging due to domain shape diversity and complex physics, motivating a robust and accurate neural operator framework.
summary_en.method: RIGNO is an end-to-end graph neural network that maps data between input/output point clouds via a downsampled regional mesh, incorporating multi-scale processing and spatio-temporal resolution invariance.
summary_en.result: The model outperforms neural operator baselines on a suite of time-dependent and steady PDE benchmarks, demonstrating robust generalization to unseen spatial and temporal resolutions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including various PDEs defined on diverse domain geometries, with comparisons to baseline neural operators.

title: PDE-DKL: PDE-constrained deep kernel learning in high dimensionality
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PDE-DKL框架结合了深度学习和高斯过程，在数据稀缺和高维PDE问题中实现了高精度和不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法在高维PDE问题中数据稀缺时精度和不确定性量化不足
summary_zh.method: 提出PDE约束的深度核学习框架，用神经网络降维后高斯过程回归
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明该方法在数据有限时仍能高精度求解高维PDE
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个高维PDE数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: Existing physics-informed methods struggle with high-dimensional PDEs when data are scarce, lacking both accuracy and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A PDE-constrained deep kernel learning framework is proposed, where neural networks learn a low-dimensional latent representation and Gaussian processes perform kernel regression under PDE constraints.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate high accuracy and robust uncertainty estimates with reduced data requirements for high-dimensional PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on several high-dimensional PDE benchmark problems.

title: Guaranteed prediction sets for functional surrogate models
relevance_to_user: 该论文为函数代理模型提供统计保证的预测集，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 为函数代理模型提供统计保证的预测集，提升PDE仿真可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 基于SVD降维和zonotope集传播构建嵌套预测集，实现共形预测覆盖保证。
summary_zh.result: 方法模型无关，适用于神经算子等复杂模型，并捕获SVD截断误差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证预测集的覆盖保证和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To provide statistically guaranteed prediction sets for functional surrogate models, motivated by the need for reliable PDE emulators.
summary_en.method: Constructs nested prediction sets on a low-dimensional SVD representation of the surrogate model's error and propagates them using zonotopes for exact linear propagation.
summary_en.result: The method is model-agnostic, applicable to Neural Operators, and preserves conformal prediction coverage guarantees while capturing SVD truncation error.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks demonstrating coverage guarantees and efficiency.

title: Digital Twin Synchronization: Bridging the Sim-RL Agent to a Real-Time Robotic Additive Manufacturing Control
relevance_to_user: 该论文将深度强化学习与数字孪生结合，用于机器人增材制造的实时自适应控制，直接涉及AI嵌入生物打印工作流程中的后处理控制环节。
why_not_core: This paper does not focus on bioprinting specifically, nor does it involve bioink, cell viability, or tissue engineering applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 将深度强化学习与数字孪生集成，实现增材制造的动态自适应控制。
summary_zh.method: 采用SAC算法结合Unity仿真与ROS2，通过迁移学习和分层奖励结构训练机器人臂。
summary_zh.result: 在仿真和物理环境中均实现快速策略收敛和鲁棒任务执行。
summary_zh.validation: 在Viper X300s机器人臂上进行模拟和物理实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To integrate deep reinforcement learning with digital twins for dynamic adaptive control in additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: The Soft Actor-Critic algorithm is combined with Unity simulation and ROS2, leveraging transfer learning and a hierarchical reward structure to train a robotic arm.
summary_en.result: Rapid policy convergence and robust task execution are achieved in both simulated and physical environments.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a Viper X300s robot arm in both simulation and physical experiments.

why_not_core: This paper uses classical computer vision rather than deep learning or AI-based decision-making, and does not demonstrate autonomous process control.

summary_zh.motivation: 生物打印缺乏过程监控和质量控制，阻碍工业转化。
summary_zh.method: 集成高分辨率相机和计算机视觉模块，定量比较打印输出与CAD模型。
summary_zh.result: 低粘度、快触变恢复和小颗粒尺寸显著提高打印保真度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过不同生物墨水、染料和支撑浴的实验验证平台兼容性和打印质量。

summary_en.motivation: Current bioprinting platforms lack process monitoring and quality control, hindering industrial translation.
summary_en.method: A novel bioprinting platform integrating a high-resolution camera and classical computer vision module for in-situ quantitative comparison of extrusion outcomes to CAD model projections.
summary_en.result: Lower viscosity, faster thixotropy recovery, and smaller particle sizes in granular support hydrogels significantly enhance print fidelity.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation with various bioinks, dyes, and support bath materials for both 2D and 3D trajectories.

title: Evidential Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的证据物理信息神经网络（EPINN）将不确定性量化（UQ）集成到PINN中，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模，解决昂贵仿真的采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, nor does it handle multi-objective constraints or patient-specific geometries.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN缺乏可靠的不确定性量化，影响科学发现的可信度。
summary_zh.method: 基于证据深度学习框架，将PDE残差和数据损失项重参数化为先验超参数函数，并加入KL散度正则化。
summary_zh.result: 相比贝叶斯PINN，对噪声更敏感，边界条件保持更好，经验覆盖概率更接近名义值。
summary_zh.validation: 在1D和2D非线性微分方程逆问题上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Physics-Informed Neural Networks lack reliable uncertainty quantification, limiting their trustworthiness in scientific discovery.
summary_en.method: The proposed Evidential PINN recasts PDE residual and data-fitting loss terms as functions of hyperparameters of an evidential prior, and incorporates a KL divergence regularizer between inverse-gamma distributions.
summary_en.result: Compared to Bayesian PINNs, the model shows higher sensitivity to data noise, better preservation of boundary conditions, and empirical coverage probabilities closer to nominal levels.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on inverse problems of 1D and 2D nonlinear differential equations using numerical benchmarks.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Training data distribution for the 1D problem. The noise amplitude 𝒜 ⁡ ( x ) \mathcal{A}(x) was set to be 0.2 for the shaded ‘high-noise’ regions and 0.02 otherwise.

title: Point Cloud Neural Operator for Parametric PDEs on Complex and Variable Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的点云神经算子方法可直接迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的参数化PDE代理建模，尤其适用于复杂几何域上的高效仿真。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address multi-objective constraints typical in implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速复杂几何域上参数化PDE的仿真计算
summary_zh.method: 提出点云神经算子(PCNO)直接在点云上学习解算子
summary_zh.result: 在边界层、自适应网格和拓扑变化域上表现良好，并成功应用于三维车辆压力预测和降落伞充气模拟
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个教学PDE问题和三维工程案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate computationally expensive simulations of parametric PDEs on geometrically complex and variable domains.
summary_en.method: Proposes the Point Cloud Neural Operator (PCNO) that directly learns solution operators on point cloud discretizations.
summary_en.result: PCNO achieves accurate predictions on problems with boundary layers, adaptively meshed point clouds, and topologically varying domains, and demonstrates practicality on 3D vehicle pressure prediction and parachute inflation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a suite of pedagogical PDE problems and two 3D engineering applications.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Architecture of the Point Cloud Neural Operator (PCNO): Starting with input function [ a ⁡ ( x ) , x , ρ ⁡ ( x , Ω ) ] [a(x),x,\rho(x,\Omega)] , it is first lifted to a higher-dimensional channel space using a pointwise neural network P P . Several point cloud neural layers are then applied, followed by a projection back to the target dimensional space using a pointwise neural network Q Q . The final output is u u .

title: DoMINO: A Decomposable Multi-scale Iterative Neural Operator for Modeling Large Scale Engineering Simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，解决昂贵仿真采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or uncertainty quantification, and lacks biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统CFD计算昂贵，ML代理模型精度和可扩展性有限。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于点云的多尺度迭代神经算子DoMINO，利用局部几何信息预测流场。
summary_zh.result: 在汽车空气动力学数据集上验证了模型的可扩展性、精度和泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 使用DrivAerML数据集进行分布内和分布外测试。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional CFD simulations are computationally expensive, and existing ML surrogates suffer from accuracy and scalability limitations.
summary_en.method: DoMINO is a point cloud-based neural operator that leverages local geometric information to predict flow fields on discrete points, implemented in NVIDIA Modulus.
summary_en.result: The model demonstrates scalability, accuracy, and generalization on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution samples for automotive aerodynamics.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the DrivAerML dataset using engineering-specific metrics for numerical simulations.

title: Stochastic Deep Learning Surrogate Models for Uncertainty Propagation in Microstructure-Properties of Ceramic Aerogels
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯CNN代理模型用于不确定性传播的方法，可迁移至植入物力学性能的随机模拟与设计优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on ceramic aerogels rather than biomedical implants or biomechanics, and does not address implant-specific constraints or patient-specific geometries.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服陶瓷气凝胶微观结构随机性对力学性能影响的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 结合格子玻尔兹曼模拟与有限元，用贝叶斯CNN构建微观结构生成和性能预测代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型能有效生成微观结构图像并准确预测应变能，实现不确定性传播。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟数据训练，测试分布内和插值形态的泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the prohibitive computational cost of repeated physics-based simulations for characterizing the impact of microstructure randomness on mechanical properties of ceramic aerogels.
summary_en.method: A framework combining Lattice Boltzmann simulations for microstructure formation and finite element analysis for mechanical properties, with Bayesian Convolutional Neural Networks as surrogate models for both microstructure generation and property prediction.
summary_en.result: The Bayesian CNN surrogate accurately predicts strain energy for in-distribution microstructures and demonstrates generalization to interpolated morphologies, enabling efficient uncertainty propagation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation using physics-based simulation data, testing on in-distribution and interpolated microstructures.

title: Deep Operator Networks for Bayesian Parameter Estimation in PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文将DeepONet与PINN结合进行贝叶斯参数估计，并量化不确定性，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address multi-objective optimization or constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PDE求解中参数未知和不确定性量化问题
summary_zh.method: 结合DeepONet与PINN，通过变分推断实现贝叶斯训练
summary_zh.result: 在1D热方程和2D反应扩散方程中实现鲁棒求解与不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准测试（1D/2D PDE）上验证

summary_en.motivation: To address unknown parameters and uncertainty quantification in PDE solving.
summary_en.method: A framework combining DeepONet with PINN, trained via variational inference for Bayesian estimation.
summary_en.result: Achieves robust forward/inverse solutions and uncertainty quantification on 1D heat and 2D reaction-diffusion equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks (1D/2D PDEs) with sparse noisy observations.

title: Physics-Informed Latent Neural Operator for Real-time Predictions of time-dependent parametric PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息潜变量神经算子方法可直接迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中，解决高维参数化PDE的实时预测问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not validate on biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address multi-objective or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有深度算子网络在处理高维时空数据时计算成本高且缺乏物理约束。
summary_zh.method: 提出PI-Latent-NO框架，耦合潜变量DeepONet与重建DeepONet，通过自动微分嵌入PDE约束。
summary_zh.result: 实现了近常数规模扩展的计算效率，在多个参数化PDE上验证了精度与实时预测能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准参数化PDE基准上进行数值验证，对比传统物理信息算子模型。

summary_en.motivation: Existing deep operator networks suffer from high computational cost and lack of physical constraints when handling high-dimensional spatiotemporal data.
summary_en.method: The proposed PI-Latent-NO framework couples a latent DeepONet with a reconstruction DeepONet, embedding PDE constraints via automatic differentiation for end-to-end training.
summary_en.result: The method achieves near-constant scaling with problem size and demonstrates significant speedups over traditional physics-informed operator models on several parametric PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard parametric PDEs are used to validate accuracy, scalability, and real-time prediction capability.

visual.caption: (a) (b) Figure 1 : Schematics of (a) the baseline physics-informed vanilla neural operator (PI-Vanilla- NO) architecture and (b) our proposed physics-informed latent neural operator (PI-Latent-NO) architecture featuring coupled DeepONets for latent representation and solution reconstruction.

title: PINN-FEM: A Hybrid Approach for Enforcing Dirichlet Boundary Conditions in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN-FEM混合方法直接解决了PINN在复杂边界条件下精度不足的问题，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification, multi-objective optimization, or application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN难以精确施加Dirichlet边界条件，影响收敛性和可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 提出PINN-FEM混合方法，在边界附近使用有限元表示以强加边界条件。
summary_zh.result: 在六个复杂度递增的实验中，PINN-FEM在精度和鲁棒性上优于标准PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证，包括多个PDE问题。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs struggle to enforce Dirichlet boundary conditions accurately, compromising convergence and reliability in complex domains.
summary_en.method: A hybrid approach, PINN-FEM, combines PINNs with finite element methods via domain decomposition to impose strong Dirichlet boundary conditions near boundaries.
summary_en.result: Across six experiments of increasing complexity, PINN-FEM demonstrates superior accuracy and robustness compared to standard PINN models.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including multiple PDE problems with increasing complexity.

title: Real-Time Decision-Making for Digital Twin in Additive Manufacturing with Model Predictive Control using Time-Series Deep Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文将模型预测控制与时间序列深度神经网络结合，实现了增材制造中熔池温度的实时决策，其数字孪生框架可直接迁移至生物打印中的过程控制与质量优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on Directed Energy Deposition (DED) for metal additive manufacturing, not on bioprinting; it lacks experimental validation with biological materials or cell-laden bioinks.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现增材制造中基于数字孪生的实时自主决策。
summary_zh.method: 提出结合TiDE时间序列深度神经网络的模型预测控制框架，实现多步预测与实时优化。
summary_zh.result: 在定向能量沉积案例中，实现了熔池温度精确跟踪与孔隙缺陷减少。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真案例验证了温度跟踪与深度约束满足性能。

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time autonomous decision-making in additive manufacturing by integrating digital twins with efficient optimization driven by accurate predictions of nonlinear systems.
summary_en.method: A simultaneous multi-step Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework is proposed, using a Time-Series Dense Encoder (TiDE) deep neural network as a surrogate model to predict future states within the prediction horizon in one shot.
summary_en.result: The proposed MPC achieves precise melt pool temperature tracking and maintains depth constraints within a targeted dilution range, reducing porosity defects, with smoother laser power profiles compared to PID control.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated through simulation case studies on Directed Energy Deposition (DED) additive manufacturing, demonstrating accurate temperature and depth predictions and effective constraint satisfaction.

title: Characterization and Machine Learning-Driven Property Prediction of a Novel Hybrid Hydrogel Bioink Considering Extrusion-Based 3D Bioprinting.

why_not_core: No experimental bioprinting validation (only rheological measurements), no autonomous decision-making, no post-printing analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有生物墨水粘度预测忽略剪切速率影响，需高效优化配方。
summary_zh.method: 采用多项式拟合、决策树和随机森林算法，基于组分重量和剪切速率预测粘度。
summary_zh.result: 随机森林模型表现最佳（R²=0.99，MAE=0.09），可加速生物墨水开发。
summary_zh.validation: 使用169组流变测量数据，80%训练20%验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing bioink viscosity predictions ignore shear rate, necessitating efficient formulation optimization.
summary_en.method: Machine learning models (polynomial fit, decision tree, random forest) predict viscosity from component weights and shear rate.
summary_en.result: Random forest achieved the best performance (R²=0.99, MAE=0.09), enabling rapid bioink formulation.

summary_en.method: Four lattice designs (auxetic bow-tie and TPMS) were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion and subjected to quasi-static mechanical and biological tests.

summary_en.motivation: To minimize stress shielding after hip prosthesis implantation by optimizing prosthesis positioning.

summary_en.validation: The optimization results are compared with the best initial design samples from a design of experiments.

summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内动物实验验证免疫调节和骨整合效果。

summary_en.motivation: Gradient microporous scaffolds mimic the pore transition of bone but immune-inflammatory responses can impair osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate Ti6Al4V gradient TPMS scaffolds with pore sizes from 650 to 350 μm, and mechanical testing, in vitro macrophage polarization, and in vivo implantation were performed.
summary_en.result: The gradient scaffold exhibited bone-matching elastic modulus, reduced stress shielding, promoted M2 macrophage polarization, and enhanced new bone formation in vivo.
summary_en.validation: Validation included mechanical testing, in vitro cell assays (macrophage polarization and osteogenic differentiation), and in vivo rat implantation with histological analysis.

title: Biomechanically optimized 3D-Printed titanium prostheses with stiffener arrangement for critical femoral diaphyseal defects: early weight-bearing capacity and combat readiness validated through integrated biomechanical-FEA approach.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, The 908th Hospital of Joint Logistic Support Force, Nanchang, Jiangxi, China.; Third Clinical Medical College of Nanchang University, Jiangxi Medical College, Nanchang University, Nanchang, Jiangxi, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Jiang-Jun Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, The 908th Hospital of Joint Logistic Support Force, Nanchang, Jiangxi, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接评估了3D打印钛合金假体在股骨缺损中的生物力学性能，包括应力遮挡和早期负重能力，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on diaphyseal defects rather than femoral stem implants, and does not quantify micromotion or contact mechanics at the bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决临界股骨干缺损的快速康复需求，评估个性化假体的生物力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过生物力学测试和有限元分析，比较两种假体与完整股骨的轴向压缩、扭转、弯曲刚度和疲劳性能。
summary_zh.result: 假体组与完整股骨压缩刚度无显著差异，应力低于屈服强度，多孔支架设计降低应力遮挡。
summary_zh.validation: 机械测试（压缩、扭转、弯曲、疲劳）结合数字图像相关验证应力分布。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the biomechanical performance of personalized 3D-printed titanium prostheses for critical femoral diaphyseal defects, aiming to enable early weight-bearing and rapid rehabilitation.
summary_en.method: Integrated biomechanical testing (axial compression, torsion, four-point bending, cyclic fatigue) and finite element analysis were performed on fourth-generation composite femurs with 10 cm defects, comparing two prosthesis designs against intact bones and diaphyseal fractures.
summary_en.result: Both prostheses achieved compressive stiffness comparable to intact femurs, with von Mises stresses below the yield strength of Ti6Al4V, and the porous scaffold design reduced stress shielding; prostheses withstood 100,000 cycles at 1800 N without failure.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (stiffness, fatigue) and digital image correlation validated the FEA-predicted stress distribution patterns.

title: An integrated experimental and analytical approach for the analysis of the mechanical interaction between metal porous scaffolds and bone: implications for stress shielding in orthopedic implants.
first_author_affiliation: IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Movement Analysis Laboratory and Functional Evaluation of Prostheses, Bologna, Italy.

corresponding_authors.name: Paolo Caravaggi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Movement Analysis Laboratory and Functional Evaluation of Prostheses, Bologna, Italy.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了多孔金属支架与骨之间的力学相互作用，包括应力遮挡和刚度匹配，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication details, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多孔金属支架对骨应力分布的影响，以减少应力遮挡。
summary_zh.method: 结合数字图像相关实验与有限元分析，评估不同孔隙率和材料对骨应变的影响。
summary_zh.result: 多孔支架使骨应变更接近完整骨，Ti6Al4V优于CoCrMo，大孔隙更有效。
summary_zh.validation: 通过牛皮质骨压缩实验验证有限元模型。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how porous metal scaffolds affect bone stress distribution to mitigate stress shielding in orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: An integrated approach combining digital image correlation experiments on bovine bone-scaffold constructs with finite element analysis and an analytical spring model.
summary_en.result: Porous scaffolds, especially Ti6Al4V with 1000 µm pores, produced bone strain and reaction forces closer to intact bone compared to solid scaffolds.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests on bovine cortical bone with inserted scaffolds validated the finite element predictions.
